chinese_original: 1953 年 12 月 24 至 25 日，石硤尾寮屋區大火，大約 53,000 人無家可歸。之後政府興建徙置大廈，成為香港公營房屋嘅起點。（來源：Wikipedia「Shek Kip Mei Estate」）
english: On 24–25 December 1953, a fire swept through the Shek Kip Mei squatter area, leaving about 53,000 people homeless. The government then built resettlement blocks, marking the start of public housing in Hong Kong. (Source: Wikipedia "Shek Kip Mei Estate")

chinese_original: 1970 年代，深水埗。你已經係中學生，屋企搬咗出嚟，喺唐樓租咗間板間房。
english: Sham Shui Po, 1970s. You're a secondary-school student now. Your family has moved out and rents a partitioned room in a tenement building.

chinese_original: 1980 年代，觀塘。你中學畢業，喺工廈度搵到一份寫字樓嘅工。
english: Kwun Tong, 1980s. You've finished secondary school and found an office job in an industrial building.

chinese_original: 1990 年代，旺角。你儲咗啲錢，喺女人街租咗個檔口，第一次自己做細老闆。
english: Mong Kok, 1990s. You've saved some money and rented a stall on Ladies' Market — your first time being your own boss.

chinese_original: 1998 年 12 月 31 日，香港取消租金管制。（來源：立法會秘書處資料研究組）2013 年 3 月 1 日起，離境旅客每人最多帶 1.8 公斤配方奶粉。（來源：香港政府新聞公報）
english: On 31 December 1998, Hong Kong abolished rent control. (Source: Research Office, Legislative Council Secretariat) From 1 March 2013, each departing traveller may take out at most 1.8 kg of powdered formula. (Source: Hong Kong Government press release)

chinese_original: 2001 年 12 月，淨化海港計劃第一期啟用，維港兩岸大約七成半污水改為送去昂船洲處理。（來源：環境保護署）
english: In December 2001, Stage 1 of the Harbour Area Treatment Scheme came into operation, and about 75% of the sewage from both sides of Victoria Harbour was sent to Stonecutters Island for treatment instead. (Source: Environmental Protection Department)

chinese_original: 2003 年春天，SARS 喺香港爆發，1,755 人受感染，299 人死亡。好多人戴口罩，街道同公共交通都冷冷清清。（來源：Hong Kong Free Press）
english: In spring 2003, SARS broke out in Hong Kong: 1,755 people were infected and 299 died. Many people wore masks, and the streets and public transport were deserted. (Source: Hong Kong Free Press)

chinese_original: 2003 年，油麻地。衫哥轉咗行，喺果欄租咗個舖位做生果批發。（虛構）
english: Yau Ma Tei, 2003. Sam Gor has switched trades and rented a shop in the Fruit Market to run a fruit wholesale business. (Fictional)

chinese_original: 2009 年 7 月 7 日，香港開始膠袋環保徵費：大約 3,000 間連鎖超市、便利店同個人護理店，每個膠袋收 5 毫。（來源：環境保護署）
english: On 7 July 2009, Hong Kong introduced the Environmental Levy on plastic shopping bags: about 3,000 chain supermarkets, convenience stores and personal-care stores charged 50 cents (5 ho) per bag. (Source: Environmental Protection Department)

chinese_original: 2011 年 5 月 1 日，香港開始實施法定最低工資，每小時 $28。（來源：Wikipedia「Minimum Wage Ordinance」）同年財政預算案將煙草稅提高 41.5%。（來源：香港吸煙與健康委員會）
english: On 1 May 2011, Hong Kong introduced a statutory minimum wage of $28 an hour. (Source: Wikipedia "Minimum Wage Ordinance") In the same year, the Budget raised tobacco duty by 41.5%. (Source: Hong Kong Council on Smoking and Health)

chinese_original: 2011 年，石硤尾。衫哥同媽媽終於排到公屋，搬咗入石硤尾邨。（虛構）
english: Shek Kip Mei, 2011. Sam Gor and Mum finally get a public housing flat and move into Shek Kip Mei Estate. (Fictional)

chinese_original: 2013 年，紅磡。衫哥喺海濱長廊附近嘅渡輪碼頭搵到份暑期工。（虛構）
english: Hung Hom, 2013. Sam Gor finds a summer job at the ferry pier near the waterfront promenade. (Fictional)

chinese_original: 2016 年，中環。衫哥大學畢業，喺中環一間寫字樓做見習生，第一次日日著恤衫返工。（虛構）
english: Central, 2016. Sam Gor has graduated from university and is a trainee at an office in Central, wearing a shirt to work every day for the first time. (Fictional)

chinese_original: 2017 年 5 月 1 日起，法定最低工資由每小時 $32.5 調高到 $34.5。（來源：勞工處）
english: From 1 May 2017, the statutory minimum wage rose from $32.5 to $34.5 an hour. (Source: Labour Department)

chinese_original: 2017 年 6 月，政府統計處公布：2016 年按原本住戶收入計，Gini coefficient 係 0.539，2011 年係 0.537；計埋稅同社會福利轉移後係 0.473。（來源：政府統計處新聞公報，2017 年 6 月 9 日）
english: In June 2017, the Census and Statistics Department announced that the 2016 Gini coefficient based on original household income was 0.539, compared with 0.537 in 2011; after taxes and social benefit transfers it was 0.473. (Source: Census and Statistics Department press release, 9 June 2017)

chinese_original: Ivy：Ch.16 稅同補貼嘅 efficiency，考你 4 題！
english: Ivy: Ch.16 efficiency of taxes and subsidies — 4 questions for you!

chinese_original: Ivy：我日日喺黃埔搭巴士返工，如果車費有補貼就平啲。
english: Ivy: I take the bus from Whampoa to work every day. If fares were subsidised, it'd be cheaper.

chinese_original: Ivy：有稅，TSS 要加 tax revenue；有補貼，就要減 subsidy expenditure。補貼令買賣雙方都開心，但可能 over-production。
english: Ivy: With a tax, TSS must add tax revenue; with a subsidy, subtract subsidy expenditure. A subsidy makes buyers and sellers happy, but may cause over-production.

chinese_original: Joey：上個月業主加租，老闆話唔使因為加租而少砌機，照砌同一個數，只係少賺咗。你估點解？
english: Joey: The landlord raised the rent last month. The boss said there's no need to build fewer computers because of it — build the same number, just earn less. Why do you think that is?

chinese_original: Joyce：呢種現金津貼係 transfer in cash 定 in kind？佢係拉近收入，定拉近機會？會唔會影響人哋工作嘅意欲？你覺得呢？
english: Joyce: Is this cash allowance a transfer in cash or in kind? Does it narrow income gaps, or gaps in opportunity? Could it affect people's incentive to work? What do you think?

chinese_original: Karen：Ch.15 surplus 同 efficiency，4 條定輸贏！
english: Karen: Ch.15 surplus and efficiency — 4 questions decide it!

chinese_original: Karen：PS 唔等於 profit：PS = profit + TFC。TSS 最大就係 MB = MC 嗰度。
english: Karen: PS doesn't equal profit: PS = profit + TFC. TSS is largest where MB = MC.

chinese_original: Karen：我喺舊工廠大廈做陶藝，每件作品都要計清楚 MC。
english: Karen: I make pottery in an old factory building, and I work out the MC of every piece.

chinese_original: Kay：Ch.20 real GDP、per capita、CPI，4 條定輸贏！
english: Kay: Ch.20 real GDP, per capita, CPI — 4 questions decide it!

chinese_original: Kay：先用 deflator 剔走物價，再除人口；仲要記住 GDP 冇計閒暇、污染同分配。
english: Kay: First use the deflator to strip out prices, then divide by population; and remember GDP leaves out leisure, pollution and distribution.

chinese_original: Kay：原來 nominal GDP 升咗唔代表生活好咗。
english: Kay: So a rise in nominal GDP doesn't mean life got better.

chinese_original: Kay：我份功課要比較兩個城市嘅生活水平。
english: Kay: My assignment is comparing living standards in two cities.

chinese_original: Kelvin：Ch.9 profit maximisation，4 條定輸贏！
english: Kelvin: Ch.9 profit maximisation — 4 questions decide it!

chinese_original: Kelvin：只要 MR 唔少過 MC 就多做一部；加租係 fixed cost，唔會改變我砌幾多部。
english: Kelvin: As long as MR isn't less than MC, I build one more; a rent rise is a fixed cost, so it doesn't change how many I build.

chinese_original: Kelvin：我喺電腦中心砌機，每砌一部都要計清楚 MC。
english: Kelvin: I build computers at the computer centre, and I work out the MC of each one.

chinese_original: Ken：MSC = MPC + MEC；有 external cost，市場就會生產太多。

chinese_original: Ken：你分得清私人同社會成本。

chinese_original: Ken：我日日喺海濱長廊跑步，有時聞到渡輪柴油味。

chinese_original: Mandy：2011–12 年度財政預算案將煙草稅提高 41.5%。（來源：香港吸煙與健康委員會）煙民好多照食，你覺得係因為 demand 好 elastic 定好 inelastic？

chinese_original: Marcus：我喺交易廣場返工，日日睇 GDP 數字。

chinese_original: Marcus：買股票、買舊樓唔係 GDP 嘅 investment；經紀佣金就計。GNI 仲要加埋外地賺返嚟嘅要素收入。

Ladies' Market stall owner Sister Fong

english: Uncle Ho: The factor income Hongkongers earn from investing and doing business abroad is more than what foreigners earn in Hong Kong and take away. What do you call this difference? Why does it make GNI bigger than GDP?

english: Many sellers vs a few big sellers

chinese_original: 婆婆拉住條繩，小艇慢慢過咗涌……
english: Granny pulls the rope, and the little boat slowly crosses the creek…

chinese_original: 媽媽：SARS 嗰陣，女人街冇乜人行，我個檔口收入跌咗好多。
english: Mum: During SARS, hardly anyone walked down Ladies' Market. My stall's income dropped a lot.

chinese_original: 媽媽：你人工同隔籬樓洗碗阿姐差好遠。你覺得呢個差距，係能力、學歷，定係其他原因造成？
english: Mum: Your pay is way off from the dishwasher lady's next door. Do you think the gap comes from ability, education, or something else?

chinese_original: 媽媽：你喺碼頭做暑期工，記得飲多啲水。（虛構）
english: Mum: You're doing a summer job at the pier, so remember to drink plenty of water. (Fictional)

chinese_original: 媽媽：你話，係啲客唔鍾意我啲貨，定係成條 demand curve 移咗？點分？
english: Mum: Tell me, is it that customers don't like my goods, or has the whole demand curve shifted? How do you tell?

chinese_original: 媽媽：你話，公屋租金低過市價，點解要排隊？如果冇排隊制度，會用咩方法分配？
english: Mum: Tell me, public housing rent is below market price, so why do we have to queue? Without a queuing system, how would the flats be allocated?

chinese_original: 媽媽：屋企打算搬出市區。準備好就去東岸碼頭搵船家，坐船出深水埗啦！
english: Mum: Our family plans to move to the city. When you're ready, find the Boatman at the East Bank pier and take the boat to Sham Shui Po!

chinese_original: 媽媽：廠入面分工好細：有人剪布、有人車袖、有人熨衫。你覺得點解咁樣會快啲？
english: Mum: Work in the factory is finely divided: some cut cloth, some sew sleeves, some iron. Why do you think that's faster?

chinese_original: 媽媽：我由深水埗嗰條車衣線，跟咗過嚟觀塘做拉長。
english: Mum: I followed my sewing line from Sham Shui Po over to Kwun Tong to be a line leader.

chinese_original: 媽媽：我而家喺長沙灣製衣廠車衣，按件計錢，即係 piece rate：車得多先賺得多。
english: Mum: I now sew at a garment factory in Cheung Sha Wan, paid by the piece — that's piece rate: the more you sew, the more you earn.

chinese_original: 媽媽：我而家買餸都自己帶袋，因為攞膠袋要俾錢。你話，收 5 毫係想改變咩行為？
english: Mum: I bring my own bag for groceries now, because plastic bags cost money. Tell me, what behaviour is the 50-cent charge meant to change?

chinese_original: 媽媽：我退咗休，搬嚟旺角同你住。你開檔要小心計數呀。
english: Mum: I've retired and moved to Mong Kok to live with you. Be careful with your sums when you run your stall!

chinese_original: 媽媽：無論點揀，都係用有限嘅資源去換最想要嘅嘢。
english: Mum: Whatever you choose, you're using limited resources to get what you want most.

chinese_original: 媽媽：第一份全職做成點？中環啲人行路好快，你記得食飯。（虛構）
english: Mum: How's your first full-time job? People in Central walk really fast. Remember to eat. (Fictional)

chinese_original: 媽媽：終於排到公屋喇！租金平過出面好多，不過我哋排咗好多年。（虛構）
english: Mum: We finally got a public housing flat! The rent's much cheaper than outside, but we queued for many years. (Fictional)

chinese_original: 媽媽：而家周老闆間廠係有限公司。佢同我講：公司蝕錢，佢間屋唔使拎去還債。你覺得點解會咁？
english: Mum: Boss Chow's factory is a limited company now. He told me that if the company loses money, he doesn't have to use his home to pay its debts. Why do you think that is?
Mum: You're back? Have a rest first.

chinese_original: 媽媽：返嚟喇？入屋食碗粥，休息吓啦。
english: Mum: You're back? Come in, have some congee and rest.

chinese_original: 媽媽：返嚟喇？公屋單位唔大，但係有自己個廚房同廁所，好過以前好多。唞吓先。
english: Mum: You're back? The public housing flat isn't big, but we have our own kitchen and toilet — much better than before. Take a rest.

chinese_original: 媽媽：返嚟喇？呢層唐樓喺旺角，出面好嘈，不過入到屋就靜晒。唞吓先。
english: Mum: You're back? This tenement building is in Mong Kok. It's noisy outside, but quiet once you're indoors. Take a rest.

chinese_original: 媽媽：返嚟喇？呢間係你喺中環附近租嘅細單位，媽媽上嚟幫你執吓屋。唞吓先。（虛構）
english: Mum: You're back? This is the small flat you rent near Central; Mum came up to help tidy it. Take a rest. (Fictional)

chinese_original: 媽媽：返嚟喇？呢間係阿姨借俾我哋暑假住嘅紅磡唐樓，望到少少海。唞吓先。（虛構）
english: Mum: You're back? This is the Hung Hom tenement flat Auntie lent us for the summer — you can see a bit of the sea. Take a rest. (Fictional)

chinese_original: 媽媽：返嚟喇？唐樓板間房細細，不過食碗粥休息吓先。
english: Mum: You're back? Our partitioned room in the tenement building is tiny, but have some congee and rest.

chinese_original: 媽媽：返嚟喇？油麻地呢間唐樓細細間，但係近果欄，你凌晨開工都方便。唞吓先。
english: Mum: You're back? This Yau Ma Tei tenement flat is small, but it's near the Fruit Market, handy for your early-morning shifts. Take a rest.

chinese_original: 媽媽：返嚟喇？觀塘呢間屋企細細，不過坐低唞吓先。
english: Mum: You're back? Our Kwun Tong home is small, but sit down and rest.

chinese_original: 媽媽：隔籬幾檔賣嘅手袋同你差唔多，但款式唔同。你覺得你可唔可以隨便加價？加咗會唔會走晒啲客？
english: Mum: The stalls next door sell handbags much like yours, but in different styles. Do you think you can raise your price freely? Would you lose all your customers if you did?

chinese_original:
揀一隻做夥伴出戰。能力點做咩用：
・ATK：每 10 點攻擊 +10%；仲有「快答暴擊」——喺時限首 40% 內答啱，有 ATK÷2 %（最多 50%）機會打出 1.5 倍傷害。
・DEF：每 10 點受傷 −10%（最多 −70%）；另有 DEF÷2.5 %（最多 40%）機會完全擋住一次傷害。
・HP：真實血量（最多 100），HP 高＝容錯多。
・同章加成：夥伴同野生 EconMon 同一章（例如都係 Ch.3），傷害 +20%。
・升級有訓練獎金（Lv×$30），Lv.5 進化仲有 $300＋及第粥，HP 回滿。
english:
Pick a partner to battle. What stat points do:
・ATK: every 10 points = +10% attack; plus "Quick-answer critical hit" — answer correctly in the first 40% of the time limit for an ATK÷2 % (max 50%) chance to deal 1.5x damage.
・DEF: every 10 points = −10% damage taken (max −70%); plus a DEF÷2.5 % (max 40%) chance to fully block one hit.
・HP: actual health (max 100); higher HP = more room for mistakes.
・Same-chapter bonus: if your partner and the wild EconMon are from the same chapter (e.g. both Ch.3), damage +20%.
・Levelling up gives a training bonus (Lv×$30); evolving at Lv.5 also gives $300 + Lucky congee and fully restores HP.

english: The driver at the Shek Kip Mei bus stop can take you to Hung Hom to learn Ch.16–17: the inefficiency of government intervention and externality.

chinese_original: 社工 Joyce：2016 年 5 月 3 日，政府開始接受「低收入在職家庭津貼」申請。（來源：立法會問題 LCQ15，2017 年 5 月 24 日）（Joyce 係虛構人物）

english: Brother Cheung: 5 mixed questions on Ch.13 to Ch.15!

chinese_original: 祥哥：可以去搵何姑娘喇。
english: Brother Cheung: Now go and find Miss Ho.

chinese_original: 祥哥：政府一時限價、一時徵稅、一時補貼，我哋做街市嘅最清楚。
english: Brother Cheung: Price caps one moment, taxes the next, then subsidies. We market traders know it best.

chinese_original: 祥哥：每一個干預都要問：價格點變、數量點變、邊個得益、有冇 deadweight loss。
english: Brother Cheung: For every intervention, ask: how does price change, how does quantity change, who gains, and is there a deadweight loss?

chinese_original: 福伯：1953 年聖誕，石硤尾寮屋區發生大火，大約 53,000 人無家可歸。政府之後喺呢度起徙置大廈，美荷樓就係其中一座。（來源：Wikipedia「Shek Kip Mei Estate」「Mei Ho House」）
english: Grandpa Fuk: On Christmas 1953, a huge fire broke out in the Shek Kip Mei squatter area, leaving about 53,000 people homeless. The government then built resettlement blocks here, and Mei Ho House is one of them. (Source: Wikipedia "Shek Kip Mei Estate", "Mei Ho House")

chinese_original: 福伯：不過市區工廠人工較高。你計過放棄咗嘅鹽田同漁船，就知道呢個選擇嘅 opportunity cost 有幾大。
english: Grandpa Fuk: But factory wages in the city are higher. Count up the salt pans and fishing boat we gave up, and you'll see how big the opportunity cost of this choice is.

chinese_original: 福伯：中環至半山自動扶梯 1993 年 10 月 15 日啟用，全長大約 800 米。（來源：Wikipedia「Central–Mid-Levels escalator」）
english: Grandpa Fuk: The Central–Mid-Levels escalator opened on 15 October 1993 and is about 800 metres long. (Source: Wikipedia "Central–Mid-Levels escalator")

chinese_original: 福伯：乖孫，你兩個徽章都拎咗。你話俾阿爺聽，我哋應該點揀？
english: Grandpa Fuk: My boy, you've won both Badges. Tell Grandpa, what should we choose?

chinese_original: 福伯：乖孫，大澳嘅鹽田同漁業越嚟越難撈，我哋一家就搬出嚟深水埗。
english: Grandpa Fuk: My boy, Tai O's salt pans and fishing got harder and harder to live on, so our family moved out to Sham Shui Po.

chinese_original: 福伯：乖孫，阿爺今日嚟觀音廟上香，順便睇吓維港。
english: Grandpa Fuk: My boy, Grandpa came to Kwun Yum Temple to burn incense today, and to take in Victoria Harbour.

chinese_original: 福伯：乖孫，阿爺今日專登嚟睇美荷樓。
english: Grandpa Fuk: My boy, Grandpa came specially to see Mei Ho House today.

chinese_original: 福伯：乖孫，阿爺同班老友喺榕樹頭落棋。
english: Grandpa Fuk: My boy, Grandpa's playing chess with old friends under the banyan tree.

chinese_original: 福伯：乖孫，阿爺坐扶手電梯上嚟睇你返工。
english: Grandpa Fuk: My boy, Grandpa rode the escalator up to see you at work.

chinese_original: 福伯：乖孫，阿爺老喇，就喺天台曬吓太陽。
english: Grandpa Fuk: My boy, Grandpa's getting old. I'll just sit on the rooftop and enjoy the sun.

chinese_original: 福伯：乖孫，阿爺退休喇，日日嚟雀鳥花園聽雀仔唱歌。
english: Grandpa Fuk: My boy, Grandpa's retired now. I come to the Bird Garden every day to hear the birds sing.

chinese_original: 福伯：以前啲污水直接倒落海，泳客同漁民蝕底，但冇人賠錢俾佢哋。你話，呢種成本叫咩？市場自己會唔會處理？
english: Grandpa Fuk: Sewage used to go straight into the sea. Swimmers and fishermen lost out, but nobody paid them anything. What do you call this kind of cost? Will the market sort it out by itself?

chinese_original: 福伯：以前我一個人做，蝕咗就自己孭。而家啲老闆開公司，蝕咗只係蝕投入咗嘅股本。你話吓：咁樣係咪對所有人都公平啲？
english: Grandpa Fuk: I used to work alone, so any losses were mine to bear. Now bosses set up companies, and if they lose, they only lose the capital they put in. What do you think: is that fairer to everyone?

chinese_original: 福伯：出市區打工……full cost 唔止車費，仲有搭車嘅時間同離開大澳嘅其他代價。
english: Grandpa Fuk: Working in the city... the full cost isn't just the fare. There's the travel time and the other costs of leaving Tai O too.

chinese_original: 福伯：出海嘅風險唔會改變 opportunity cost，但會影響我哋覺得出海值唔值。仲要諗清楚借錢買機動船嘅利息。
english: Grandpa Fuk: The risk of going to sea doesn't change the opportunity cost, but it does affect whether we think it's worth it. And we must think about the interest on a loan for a motorboat.

chinese_original: 福伯：出海打魚……1954 到 1958 年黃花魚大跌，魚係越嚟越 scarce。
english: Grandpa Fuk: Fishing at sea... from 1954 to 1958 the yellow croaker catch crashed. Fish became more and more scarce.

chinese_original: 福伯：呢個花園 1997 年落成，雀仔街啲檔口因為市區重建搬晒嚟呢度。（來源：Wikipedia「Mong Kok」）
english: Grandpa Fuk: This garden was completed in 1997. The stalls on Bird Street all moved here because of urban renewal. (Source: Wikipedia "Mong Kok")

chinese_original: 福伯：呢間天后廟 1876 年建成，廟街就係因為呢間廟而得名。（來源：Wikipedia「Yau Ma Tei」）
english: Grandpa Fuk: This Tin Hau Temple was built in 1876. Temple Street is named after it. (Source: Wikipedia "Yau Ma Tei")

chinese_original: 福伯：徙置區租金好低，但係單位唔夠分，要登記輪候。你話，價格唔可以升嘅時候，係用咩方法決定邊個先上樓？
english: Grandpa Fuk: Resettlement rents were very low, but there weren't enough flats, so people had to register and queue. When the price can't rise, what decides who gets a flat first?

chinese_original: 福伯：我哋唔應該因為鹽田已經起咗先留低，嗰啲係 historical cost。留低，要因為我哋真係覺得曬鹽值得。
english: Grandpa Fuk: We shouldn't stay just because the salt pans are already built. That's historical cost. We stay only if we truly think salt-making is worth it.

chinese_original: 福伯：我由大澳曬鹽、到深水埗睇住你媽媽車衣，而家睇住你入寫字樓。
english: Grandpa Fuk: I went from making salt in Tai O, to watching your Mum sew in Sham Shui Po, and now I'm watching you go into an office.

chinese_original: 福伯：戰後初期，好多工廠都集中喺深水埗同長沙灣。你睇街上啲布檔，由布到衫，要經過幾多人手？
english: Grandpa Fuk: Right after the war, many factories clustered in Sham Shui Po and Cheung Sha Wan. Look at the fabric stalls on the street: from cloth to clothes, how many hands does it pass through?

chinese_original: 福伯：政府當年起呢條扶梯嘅開支，計唔計入 GDP？如果計，屬於 C、I、G 定 X − M？你諗諗。
english: Grandpa Fuk: Does the government's spending on building this escalator count in GDP? If so, is it C, I, G or X − M? Have a think.

chinese_original: 福伯：留低曬鹽……咁我哋放棄咗嘅，係出市區打工嗰份收入，呢個就係 opportunity cost。
english: Grandpa Fuk: Stay and make salt... then what we give up is the income from working in the city. That's the opportunity cost.

chinese_original: 福伯：維港渡海泳 1906 年開始，1970 年代尾因為海水污染停辦，2011 年先復辦。（來源：Openwaterpedia「Hong Kong Cross-Harbour Swim」）
english: Grandpa Fuk: The Victoria Harbour cross-harbour swim began in 1906, stopped in the late 1970s because of water pollution, and only returned in 2011. (Source: Openwaterpedia "Hong Kong Cross-Harbour Swim")

chinese_original: 福伯：阿爺以前曬鹽係 primary production，你媽媽車衣係 secondary production，布檔賣布係 tertiary production。你分唔分到？
english: Grandpa Fuk: Grandpa making salt was primary production, your Mum sewing was secondary production, and the fabric stall selling cloth is tertiary production. Can you tell them apart?

chinese_original: 福伯：阿爺以前曬鹽，落大雨就冇鹽賣，價錢即刻升。你話，嗰陣係 demand 變咗，定係 supply 變咗？
english: Grandpa Fuk: When Grandpa made salt, heavy rain meant no salt to sell, and the price shot up. Was that a change in demand, or in supply?

chinese_original: 福伯：阿爺曬鹽嗰陣，一斤鹽邊個賣都一樣價；你而家賣手袋，每檔款式都唔同。兩種市場有咩分別？你話俾阿爺聽。
english: Grandpa Fuk: When Grandpa made salt, a catty of salt cost the same whoever sold it. Now you sell handbags, and every stall has different styles. How are these two markets different? Tell Grandpa.

english: Staff: The third Mock Exam Hall opens after you get the Intervention Badge. Go and find Miss Ho at the estate Gym!

chinese_original: 職員：第二個模擬試場要拎到市場徽章之後先開放。去搵金魚街標叔啦！

船家好叔：2017 年第三季，香港 GNI 係 7,080 億元，GDP 係 6,798 億元，GNI 高過 GDP 282 億元。（來源：政府統計處新聞公報，2017 年 12 月 14 日）（好叔係虛構人物）
english: Boatman Uncle Ho: In Q3 2017, Hong Kong's GNI was HK$708.0 billion and GDP was HK$679.8 billion, so GNI was HK$28.2 billion higher than GDP. (Source: Census and Statistics Department press release, 14 December 2017) (Uncle Ho is fictional)

chinese_original: 船家強叔：我喺維港行船三十年。2001 年 12 月淨化海港計劃第一期啟用，維港兩岸大約七成半污水送去昂船洲處理。（來源：環境保護署）（強叔係虛構人物）
english: Boatman Uncle Keung: I've sailed Victoria Harbour for thirty years. In December 2001, Stage 1 of the Harbour Area Treatment Scheme opened, sending about three-quarters of the sewage from both sides of the harbour to Stonecutters Island for treatment. (Source: Environmental Protection Department) (Uncle Keung is fictional)

chinese_original: 船家：PVP 對戰區？坐穩啦，開船！
english: Boatman: PVP battle zone? Hold on tight, we're off!

chinese_original: 船家：出市區？要等你拎齊鹽花同墟市兩個徽章先啦。大澳嘅嘢未學完，出到去都唔明㗎。
english: Boatman: Into the city? Not until you've got both the Salt-flower and Market-town Badges. If you haven't finished learning Tai O's lessons, you won't understand anything out there.

chinese_original: 船家：粉嶺？嘩，你攞到粉嶺船票喎！不過呢條航線仲準備緊，要等下次更新先開船。張船票你收好佢！
english: Boatman: Fanling? Wow, you've got a Fanling ferry ticket! But this route is still being prepared and will open in a future update. Keep that ticket safe!

chinese_original: 船慢慢駛離大澳，你望住棚屋越嚟越細……
english: The boat slowly pulls away from Tai O, and you watch the stilt houses grow smaller and smaller...

花墟

english:
Flower Market

chinese_original: 芳姐：Ch.8 到 Ch.10 溝埋考你 5 題！

chinese_original: 芳姐：好，可以去搵標叔喇。
english: Sister Fong: Good, now go and find Uncle Biu.

chinese_original: 芳姐：我哋呢啲檔口係 price searcher：加價會走咗部分客，唔會走晒，所以要靠款式同服務留客。
english: Sister Fong: Stalls like ours are price searchers. Raise prices and we lose some customers, not all, so we keep them with styles and service.

chinese_original: 芳姐：我喺女人街擺咗廿幾年檔，由賣女裝賣到賣手袋。
english: Sister Fong: I've run a stall on Ladies' Market for twenty-odd years, from women's clothes to handbags.

chinese_original: 華姐：Ch.18 收入差距，答啱 4 題先當你贏！
english: Sister Wah: Ch.18 Income inequality. Get 4 right to win!

chinese_original: 華姐：你識得分析點解人工唔同。
english: Sister Wah: You can analyse why wages differ.

chinese_original: 華姐：天賦、human capital、厭惡性工作補償、擁有資本，都會令收入唔平均；唔平均唔一定唔公平。
english: Sister Wah: Talent, human capital, compensation for unpleasant jobs and owning capital all make incomes unequal. Unequal isn't necessarily unfair.

chinese_original: 華姐：我喺嘉咸街賣咗三十年菜，對面寫字樓啲人一個月賺我成年。
english: Sister Wah: I've sold vegetables on Graham Street for thirty years. The office workers across the road earn in a month what I make in a year.

chinese_original: 藝術中心 Mandy：呢座舊工廠大廈而家變咗藝術中心，我喺度租工作室。（虛構人物）
english: Mandy from the arts centre: This old factory building is now an arts centre. I rent a studio here. (fictional)

chinese_original: 藥房李生：2013 年 3 月 1 日起，每名 16 歲或以上離境旅客，24 小時內只可以帶 1.8 公斤配方奶粉，大約兩罐。（來源：香港政府新聞公報）（李生係虛構人物）
english: Mr Lee from the pharmacy: From 1 March 2013, each departing traveller aged 16 or above may take only 1.8 kg of formula milk powder within 24 hours, about two tins. (Source: Hong Kong Government press release) (Mr Lee is fictional)

chinese_original:
蝦醬曬場　碼頭
曬場同漁網上有 EconMon。
english:
Shrimp-paste drying ground　Pier
EconMon hide on the drying ground and fishing nets.

chinese_original: 行路速度 +1 級 Walk speed +1
街上有布檔、後巷有工場，天台有人養白鴿。每一樣都同「生產」有關：點樣分工？用咩生產要素？成本點計？
english: Fabric stalls on the street, workshops in the back lanes, pigeons on the rooftops. Everything relates to "production": how is work divided? Which factors of production are used? How are costs counted?

chinese_original: 衫哥嘅目標：盡力捉晒啲 EconMon、打贏每一間道館，賺多啲錢，買新衫俾自己！
english: Sam Gor's goal: catch every EconMon, beat every Gym, earn more money and buy himself new clothes!

chinese_original: 衫哥最鍾意兩樣嘢：第一係經濟學，第二係換新衫。個花名就係咁嚟：村入面最鍾意著新衫嘅，一定係佢。
english: Sam Gor loves two things: first, economics; second, new clothes. That's how he got his nickname: whoever loves new clothes most in the village, it's him.

chinese_original: 衫哥諗：錢得咁多，想買嘅衫就無限——點揀先最抵？（提示：scarcity 同 opportunity cost）
english: Sam Gor thinks: money is limited, but the clothes I want are endless. How do I choose for the best value? (Hint: scarcity and opportunity cost)

chinese_original: 衫哥阿爺福伯喺鹽田曬咗幾十年鹽。二戰之後入口鹽平，大澳鹽業越嚟越難做；1954 到 1958 年，黃花魚漁獲亦大跌。
english: Sam Gor's grandpa, Grandpa Fuk, made salt in the salt pans for decades. After WWII, imported salt was cheap and Tai O's salt trade grew harder; from 1954 to 1958 the yellow croaker catch also crashed.

chinese_original:

樓上係會計樓同股票行，Ch.6 EconMon 喺大堂出沒。
english:
Yue Man Square offices ↑
Upstairs are accounting firms and stockbrokers. Ch.6 EconMon are found in the lobby.

Garment factory (Gym)

chinese_original: 觀塘 1954 年開始規劃做工業區，1954 至 1962 年分三期填海。1961 年呢度得大約 100 間工廠、15,000 個工人。
english: Kwun Tong was planned as an industrial area from 1954, with land reclaimed in three phases from 1954 to 1962. In 1961 there were only about 100 factories and 15,000 workers here.

chinese_original:
觀塘工業區
1954 年開始規劃做工業區，1954–62 年分三期填海。
english:
Kwun Tong Industrial Area
Planned as an industrial area from 1954; reclaimed in three phases in 1954–62.

碼頭 1960 年由牛頭角搬到呢度。

Kwun Tong Pier
The pier moved here from Ngau Tau Kok in 1960.

chinese_original: 角色會轉四個方向俾你睇。滿意先買。
english: Your character turns in four directions for you. Buy only if you're happy.

chinese_original: 設為夥伴 Set as partner
試場規則：唔准出聲，計時開始就唔可以暫停。
english: Exam hall rules: no talking, and the timer can't be paused once it starts.

chinese_original: 請填姓名、班別同學號。Please fill in name, class and class no.
english: Please fill in name, class and class no.

chinese_original: 請用真實姓名、班別同學號登入，進度會同步到老師嘅紀錄。Use your real name, class and class number.
english: Log in with your real name, class and class number. Progress syncs to your teacher's records.
chinese_only: 請用真實姓名、班別同學號登入，進度會同步到老師嘅紀錄。

chinese_original: 諗吓兩隻 EconMon 各自代表咩概念。
english: Think about which concept each of the two EconMon stands for.

chinese_original: 警員：大澳街市買賣主要睇價錢。兩種方法有咩分別？廟前可能捉到 Commandra 同你講。
english: Police officer: In the Tai O market, buying and selling mostly depends on price. How do the two methods differ? You might catch Commandra in front of the temple to tell you.

chinese_original: 警員：如果乜都由政府落命令決定，就叫 planned economy。
english: Police officer: If everything is decided by government orders, it's called a planned economy.

english: Cross the harbour to Kwun Tong to learn Ch.6 ownership of firms and Ch.7 growth of firms.

chinese_original: 過海巴士駛入紅磡海底隧道，出返嚟就係港島……
english: The cross-harbour bus enters the Cross-Harbour Tunnel in Hung Hom, and comes out on Hong Kong Island...

chinese_original: 道場入面人山人海，全部都喺度等排位。搵門口嘅登記員排隊啦！
english: The dojo is packed. Everyone's waiting for ranked matches. Queue up with the registrar at the door!

chinese_original: 道場師兄：去到鑽石有段位稱號同鑽石戰衣；挑戰者有彩虹火焰神裝；全校第一嘅 Challenger 1 仲會攞到去粉嶺嘅船票。
english: Dojo senior: Reach Diamond for a rank title and the Diamond battle suit; Challengers get the Rainbow Flame legendary outfit; and the school's No.1, Challenger 1, also wins a ferry ticket to Fanling.

chinese_original: 道場師兄：排位賽係回合制 1v1。系統會喺雙方 6 隻隊伍入面各隨機抽一隻。
english: Dojo senior: Ranked matches are turn-based 1v1. The system randomly picks one from each side's team of 6.

chinese_original: 道場師兄：輪到你，就要答對手 EconMon 嘅題目；輪到對手，佢就答你隻嘅題目。每人每場只可以回血一次，諗清楚幾時用！
english: Dojo senior: On your turn, you answer a question about your opponent's EconMon; on their turn, they answer one about yours. Each player can heal only once per match, so choose your moment!
Who bears it depends on elasticity

chinese_original: 邊際收益等於邊際成本擊
鄧 Sir 都喺公園教夜校。去搵佢，再搵阿哥問路。捉到八成 Ch.3–5 EconMon、打贏 4 個對戰玩家，就可以挑戰製衣廠嘅 May 姐！
english: Mr Tang also teaches night school in the park. Go and find him, then ask Big Bro for directions. Catch 80% of Ch.3–5 EconMon and beat 4 trainers, and you can challenge Sister May at the garment factory!

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：Ch.10 最常錯係將 change in demand 同 change in quantity demanded 撈亂。價格改變，係沿住條線郁，定係成條線移？你覺得呢？
english: Mr Tang: The most common Ch.10 mistake is mixing up change in demand and change in quantity demanded. When price changes, do we move along the curve, or does the whole curve shift? What do you think?

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：Ch.11 答題四步：邊個因素？影響買家定賣家？邊條線向邊移？Pe 同 Qe 點變？
english: Mr Tang: Four steps for Ch.11: Which factor? Does it affect buyers or sellers? Which curve shifts which way? How do Pe and Qe change?

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：Ch.12 記住：elasticity 用百分比，唔係用斜率。加價之後 TR 升定跌，你覺得要睇咩？
english: Mr Tang: For Ch.12 remember: elasticity uses percentages, not slope. After a price rise, does TR go up or down? What do you think it depends on?

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：Ch.13 第一步永遠係：個管制有冇效？上限要低過 Pe、下限要高過 Pe、配額要低過 Qe。之後先講 shortage 定 surplus，成交量係邊個。
english: Mr Tang: For Ch.13 the first step is always: is the control effective? A ceiling must be below Pe, a floor above Pe, and a quota below Qe. Only then talk about shortage or surplus and the quantity transacted.

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：Ch.14 記住：稅移 supply，唔係移 demand；邊個負擔多啲，你覺得要睇咩？Ch.15 就用 TSS = Σ(MB − MC) 睇有冇 deadweight loss。
english: Mr Tang: For Ch.14 remember: a tax shifts supply, not demand. Who bears more of it, and what do you think that depends on? For Ch.15, use TSS = Σ(MB − MC) to see if there's a deadweight loss.

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：Ch.16 第一步：同 Qe 比，成交量少咗定多咗？少咗係 under-production，多咗係 over-production，兩樣都有 deadweight loss。稅收同補貼點樣計入 TSS，你覺得呢？
english: Mr Tang: Ch.16 step one: compared with Qe, is the quantity transacted lower or higher? Lower is under-production, higher is over-production, and both have a deadweight loss. How do tax revenue and subsidies count in TSS, do you think?

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：Ch.17 第一步：邊個係第三者？佢承受成本，定得到好處？之後先比較 MSC 同 MPC、MSB 同 MPB。
english: Mr Tang: Ch.17 step one: who is the third party? Do they bear a cost or receive a benefit? Then compare MSC with MPC, and MSB with MPB.

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：Ch.18 第一步：Lorenz curve 離對角線遠啲定近啲？Gini 係 A ÷ (A + B)，唔係 A ÷ B。拉近收入同拉近機會，你分得清嗎？
english: Mr Tang: Ch.18 step one: is the Lorenz curve further from or closer to the diagonal? Gini is A ÷ (A + B), not A ÷ B. Can you tell narrowing incomes from narrowing opportunities?

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：Ch.19–20 第一步：呢樣嘢係咪今年喺本地新生產？計 value added 定銷售額？數字係 nominal 定 real？你覺得呢？
english: Mr Tang: Ch.19–20 step one: was this newly produced locally this year? Count value added or sales value? Are the figures nominal or real? What do you think?

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：Ch.6 每次問自己一句就通晒：間廠有冇 incorporate？有，就有獨立法人、limited liability、perpetual succession；冇，就三樣都冇。
english: Mr Tang: For Ch.6, ask yourself one question and it all clicks: is the firm incorporated? If yes, it has separate legal entity, limited liability and perpetual succession; if not, it has none of the three.

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：Ch.7 問另一句：有冇第二間廠商參與？冇就 internal，有就 external。之後先再分 horizontal、vertical、lateral 定 conglomerate。你覺得呢？
english: Mr Tang: For Ch.7, ask another question: is a second firm involved? No means internal, yes means external. Then classify as horizontal, vertical, lateral or conglomerate. What do you think?

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：Ch.8 問四樣：賣家幾多、產品同唔同、入行難唔難、資訊夠唔夠。Ch.9 問一樣：多做一單位，MR 仲夠唔夠 MC？
english: Mr Tang: For Ch.8, ask four things: how many sellers, are the products the same, is entry hard, is information enough? For Ch.9, ask one: for one more unit, does MR still cover MC?

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：START 可以開選單：Econ-dex、隊伍（換夥伴）同背包。福伯同海姐會喺館門口等你。出發啦！
english: Mr Tang: Press START to open the menu: Econ-dex, team (switch partner) and Bag. Grandpa Fuk and Sister Hoi will wait for you at the Gym door. Off you go!

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：三隻都係 Rare 稀有級，能力差唔多，揀你最想明白嗰個概念啦。
english: Mr Tang: All three are Rare, with similar stats. Pick the concept you most want to understand.

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：你覺得呢？就算你冇揀呢隻，你都唔可能同時擁有另外兩隻。你真正「失去」嘅係邊一個？
english: Mr Tang: What do you think? Even if you didn't pick this one, you couldn't have both of the other two at once. Which one do you really "lose"?

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：唔使俾錢，唔代表冇成本。你揀咗一隻，就放棄咗其他選擇。再諗吓。
english: Mr Tang: Not paying money doesn't mean there's no cost. Picking one means giving up the other choices. Think again.

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：唔識可以撳「提示」，不過要扣 10 HP。你覺得呢：直接估，定係先諗清楚？
english: Mr Tang: If you're stuck, press "Hint", but it costs 10 HP. What do you think: guess straight away, or think it through first?

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：啱！Opportunity cost 只計放棄咗嘅選擇入面價值最高嗰一個。
english: Mr Tang: Correct! Opportunity cost counts only the highest-valued option among those given up.

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：屋企門口個阿哥會教你點操作；地圖上閃吓閃吓嘅地方可能收埋寶物，記得周圍探索！
english: Mr Tang: Big Bro at your front door will teach you the controls. Sparkling spots on the map may hide treasure, so explore everywhere!

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：我呢度有三隻 EconMon，你只可以揀一隻。
english: Mr Tang: I have three EconMon here, and you can pick only one.

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：每答啱一題，你嘅夥伴就會攻擊一次；將野生 EconMon 嘅 HP 打到 0 先捉到。稀有度越高，要答啱越多題。答錯唔緊要，嗰題遲啲會再出。
english: Mr Tang: Each right answer lets your partner attack once. Bring a wild EconMon's HP to 0 to catch it. The higher the rarity, the more right answers you need. Wrong answers are fine; that question will come back later.

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：留意吓身邊：一件恤衫由棉花、織布、車衣到舖頭，每一步屬於邊種 production？你覺得呢？
english: Mr Tang: Look around you: a shirt goes from cotton, to weaving, to sewing, to the shop. Which kind of production is each step? What do you think?

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：要真係明白一個概念，先捉得到佢：答啱題目就攻擊，將野生 EconMon 嘅 HP 打到 0。答錯或者超時，你嘅 EconMon 會受傷。
english: Mr Tang: You can only catch a concept once you truly understand it: answer right to attack and bring the wild EconMon's HP to 0. Answer wrong or run out of time, and your EconMon gets hurt.

chinese_original: 鄧 Sir：連續答啱 3 題有道具，答啱題仲有錢賺；夥伴答得多會升級，Lv.5 仲會進化。打贏咗嘅館可以喺選單「傳送」即刻返去。
english: Mr Tang: 3 right answers in a row earns an item, and right answers earn money too. Partners level up as they answer, and evolve at Lv.5. Gyms you've beaten can be reached instantly with "Fast travel" in the menu.

chinese_original: 鄭太：上個月我加咗一成價，啲客走咗三成，收入少咗好多。咁我啲玉鈪嘅 demand 係 elastic 定 inelastic？
english: Mrs Cheng: Last month I raised prices by 10%, 30% of my customers left, and my revenue fell a lot. So is demand for my jade bangles elastic or inelastic?

chinese_original:
金魚街
一袋袋金魚掛滿舖頭門口。
english:
Goldfish Street
Bags of goldfish hang all over the shopfronts.

chinese_original:
長沙灣工廠區 ↑
工廠卸貨區有 EconMon 出沒。
english:
Cheung Sha Wan industrial area ↑
EconMon appear in the factory loading bays.

chinese_original: 開支 = 補貼 × 新 Q
阿 B：你諗吓：冇 private property rights，邊個敢同你交換？冇交換，邊個敢淨做一樣嘢？
english: Ah B: Think about it: without private property rights, who'd dare trade with you? And without trade, who'd dare specialise in just one thing?

chinese_original: 阿 B：夠膽就答我 4 題 Ch.2！
english: Ah B: Brave enough? Answer 4 Ch.2 questions!

chinese_original: 阿 B：我喺碼頭搬貨，成日見人用錢換貨、用貨換貨。
english: Ah B: I move cargo at the pier, and I'm always seeing people swap money for goods and goods for goods.
Ah Ken: Good, you can tell them apart.

chinese_original: 阿 Ken：我喺裕民坊間會計樓做嘢，日日睇股票同債券。
english: Ah Ken: I work at an accounting firm at Yue Man Square, looking at stocks and bonds every day.

chinese_original: 阿 Ken：答啱 4 條 Ch.6 題，我先信你識分股同債。
english: Ah Ken: Get 4 Ch.6 questions right and I'll believe you know shares from bonds.

chinese_original: 阿 Ken：股東係 owner，有盈利先有 dividend；債券持有人係 creditor，蝕錢都要收 interest。
english: Ah Ken: Shareholders are owners and only get a dividend if there's a profit; bondholders are creditors and still collect interest even when the firm loses money.

chinese_original: 阿俊：Ch.13 價格同數量管制，答啱 4 題先當你贏！
english: Ah Tsun: Ch.13 price and quantity controls. Get 4 right and you win!

chinese_original: 阿俊：Price ceiling 要低過 Pe 先有效，會出現 shortage；成交量係 Qs，即係細嗰邊。
english: Ah Tsun: A price ceiling only works if it's below Pe, and it causes a shortage; the quantity traded is Qs, the smaller side.
Ah Tsun: You've got it all sorted.

chinese_original: 阿俊：我屋企租劏房，業主話租金唔可以再加，但係而家成日話冇房出租。
english: Ah Tsun: My family rents a subdivided flat. The landlord says the rent can't go up any more, but now everyone says there are no flats to rent.

chinese_original: 阿健：Ch.11 需求同供應嘅變化，答啱 4 題先當你贏！
english: Ah Kin: Ch.11 changes in demand and supply. Get 4 right and you win!
Ah Kin: You've got it all sorted.

chinese_original: 阿健：凌晨四點我已經推緊車仔搬生果。颱風一嚟，今日到貨少咗一半！
english: Ah Kin: By 4 a.m. I'm already pushing my trolley of fruit. A typhoon hit, and today's deliveries are down by half!

chinese_original: 阿健：記住：颱風影響嘅係賣家，所以係 supply 左移；啲生果貴咗，買家少買咗，只係沿住 demand curve 郁。
english: Ah Kin: Remember: the typhoon affects sellers, so supply shifts left; the fruit gets pricier and buyers buy less, which is just a movement along the demand curve.

chinese_original: 阿傑：地方（fixed factor）唔變，一直加 variable factor，MP 最終會跌：呢個就係 law of diminishing marginal returns。
english: Ah Kit: Space (the fixed factor) stays the same, keep adding the variable factor, and MP eventually falls: that's the law of diminishing marginal returns.

chinese_original: 阿傑：天台地方有限，白鴿越養越多就越迫。
english: Ah Kit: Rooftop space is limited, so the more pigeons I keep, the more cramped it gets.

chinese_original: 阿傑：用 4 條 Ch.5 題同我比過！
english: Ah Kit: Take me on with 4 Ch.5 questions!

chinese_original: 阿哥：中環到喇！方向掣行路、A 傾偈、START 開選單，同之前一樣。
english: Big Bro: Here's Central! D-pad to walk, A to talk, START for the menu, same as before.

chinese_original: 阿哥：你覺得呢：揀邊隻做夥伴先出去捉嘢最好？撳 START 睇吓佢哋嘅 ATK、DEF 同 HP 先決定啦。
english: Big Bro: What do you think: which one makes the best partner for catching EconMon? Press START to check their ATK, DEF and HP before you decide.

chinese_original: 阿哥：又見面！觀塘同深水埗一樣玩法：方向掣行路、A 傾偈、START 開選單。
english: Big Bro: We meet again! Kwun Tong works like Sham Shui Po: D-pad to walk, A to talk, START for the menu.

chinese_original: 阿哥：地圖上閃吓閃吓嘅位係隱藏寶物，行上去就拎到。全隊冇晒 HP 會損失三成金錢，所以記得帶粥！
english: Big Bro: Sparkling spots on the map are hidden treasures; walk onto them to pick them up. If your whole team runs out of HP you lose 30% of your money, so bring congee!

chinese_original: 阿哥：巴士站個司機可以車你返大澳。打贏咗嘅館，可以用選單「傳送」即刻飛過去。
english: Big Bro: The driver at the bus stop can take you back to Tai O. For Gyms you've beaten, use "Fast travel" in the menu to fly straight there.

chinese_original: 阿哥：撳 START 開選單：Econ-dex、隊伍（換夥伴）、筆記、成就、背包同快速傳送。
english: Big Bro: Press START for the menu: Econ-dex, Team (switch partners), Journal, Awards, Bag and Fast travel.

chinese_original: 阿哥：新嚟？我教你玩！方向掣（或者鍵盤方向鍵）行路；A 掣同人傾偈、睇告示牌；B 掣係返回。
english: Big Bro: New here? I'll show you how! Use the D-pad (or arrow keys) to walk; the A button talks to people and reads signs; the B button goes back.

chinese_original: 阿哥：旺角好多嘢睇！方向掣行路、A 傾偈、START 開選單，同之前一樣。
english: Big Bro: Lots to see in Mong Kok! D-pad to walk, A to talk, START for the menu, same as before.

chinese_original: 阿哥：歡迎嚟到深水埗！呢度同大澳一樣：方向掣行路、A 傾偈、START 開選單。
english: Big Bro: Welcome to Sham Shui Po! Same as Tai O: D-pad to walk, A to talk, START for the menu.

chinese_original: 阿哥：油麻地到喇！方向掣行路、A 傾偈、START 開選單，同之前一樣。
english: Big Bro: Here's Yau Ma Tei! D-pad to walk, A to talk, START for the menu, same as before.

chinese_original: 阿哥：石硤尾到喇！方向掣行路、A 傾偈、START 開選單，同之前一樣。
english: Big Bro: Here's Shek Kip Mei! D-pad to walk, A to talk, START for the menu, same as before.

chinese_original: 阿哥：碼頭旁邊個司機可以車你返深水埗。打贏咗嘅館，全部都可以喺選單「傳送」飛返去。
english: Big Bro: The driver by the pier can take you back to Sham Shui Po. Any Gym you've beaten, you can fly back to with "Fast travel" in the menu.

chinese_original: 阿哥：紅磡到喇！方向掣行路、A 傾偈、START 開選單，同之前一樣。
english: Big Bro: Here's Hung Hom! D-pad to walk, A to talk, START for the menu, same as before.

chinese_original: 阿哥：行入鹽田、紅樹林、蘆葦叢、沙灘石池呢啲地帶就會遇到野生 EconMon。答啱題就攻擊，將佢 HP 打到 0 就捉到。
english: Big Bro: Walk into the salt pans, mangroves, reed beds or beach rock pools to meet wild EconMon. Answer correctly to attack; bring its HP to 0 to catch it.

chinese_original: 阿哥：西北係工廈走廊，東北係裕民坊寫字樓大堂；西南係工廈天台，東南係貨倉同碼頭；館喺西南面裕民坊廣場。
english: Big Bro: Northwest is the industrial-building corridor, northeast is the Yue Man Square office lobby; southwest is the factory rooftop, southeast is the warehouse and pier. The Gym is at Yue Man Square plaza in the southwest.

chinese_original: 阿哥：西北係果欄，中間係天后廟前地，東北係油麻地街市；西南係避風塘同玉器市場，中間向南係廟街夜市。
english: Big Bro: Northwest is the Fruit Market, the middle is the Tin Hau Temple square, northeast is Yau Ma Tei Market; southwest is the typhoon shelter and Jade Market, and south of centre is the Temple Street Night Market.

chinese_original: 阿哥：西北係美荷樓，中間係石硤尾公園，東北係舊工廠大廈；西南係棚仔布市場，中間係屋邨街市。
english: Big Bro: Northwest is Mei Ho House, the middle is Shek Kip Mei Park, northeast is the old factory building; southwest is the Cloth Market, and the middle has the estate market.

chinese_original: 阿哥：西北係觀音廟，北面係紅磡街市，東北係黃埔；南面係海濱長廊同碼頭。
english: Big Bro: Northwest is Kwun Yum Temple, north is Hung Hom Market, northeast is Whampoa; south is the waterfront promenade and the pier.

chinese_original: 阿哥：西北係金魚街，東北係電腦中心；西南係女人街同花墟，東南係波鞋街、雀鳥花園同旺角街市。
english: Big Bro: Northwest is Goldfish Street, northeast is the Computer Centre; southwest is Ladies' Market and the Flower Market, southeast is Sneakers Street, the Bird Garden and Mong Kok Market.

chinese_original: 阿哥：西北係香港公園，北面係嘉咸街同扶手電梯，東北係交易廣場；南面係皇后像廣場同中環碼頭。
english: Big Bro: Northwest is Hong Kong Park, north is Graham Street and the Escalator, northeast is Exchange Square; south is Statue Square and Central Pier.

chinese_original: 阿哥：西北面係布行街同唐樓後巷，再上面係天台；東北面係長沙灣工廠區；西南面係公園水池；製衣廠（館）喺東南面。
english: Big Bro: Northwest is Cloth Street and the tenement back alleys, with the rooftops above; northeast is the Cheung Sha Wan factory area; southwest is the park pond; the garment factory (the Gym) is in the southeast.

chinese_original: 阿哥：頭頂有「VS」嘅係對戰玩家，要打贏佢哋先可以挑戰館主；有「$」嘅係小販，可以用錢買粥同道具。
english: Big Bro: People with "VS" over their heads are trainers; beat them before you can challenge the Gym Leader. Those with "$" are hawkers who sell congee and items.

chinese_original: 阿哥：館喺中間，梁工喺門口等你。巴士站個司機可以車你返石硤尾；攞到海港徽章，另一個司機仲會車你過海去中環。
english: Big Bro: The Gym is in the middle, and Engineer Leung is waiting at the door. The driver at the bus stop can take you back to Shek Kip Mei; get the Harbour Badge and another driver will take you across the harbour to Central.

chinese_original: 阿哥：館喺中間，程小姐喺門口等你。巴士站個司機可以車你過海返紅磡。
english: Big Bro: The Gym is in the middle, and Ms Ching is waiting at the door. The driver at the bus stop can take you back across the harbour to Hung Hom.

chinese_original: 阿哥：館喺果欄南面，蘭姐喺門口等你。巴士站個司機可以車你返旺角。
english: Big Bro: The Gym is south of the Fruit Market, and Sister Lan is waiting at the door. The driver at the bus stop can take you back to Mong Kok.

chinese_original: 阿哥：館喺花墟南面，標叔喺門口等你。模擬試場喺東南面；小巴站個司機可以車你返觀塘。
english: Big Bro: The Gym is south of the Flower Market, and Uncle Biu is waiting at the door. The Mock Exam Hall is in the southeast; the driver at the minibus stop can take you back to Kwun Tong.

chinese_original: 阿哥：館喺街市南面，何姑娘喺門口等你。巴士站嘅司機可以車你返油麻地；攞到干預徽章，另一個司機仲會車你去紅磡。
english: Big Bro: The Gym is south of the market, and Miss Ho is waiting at the door. The driver at the bus stop can take you back to Yau Ma Tei; get the Intervention Badge and another driver will take you to Hung Hom.

chinese_original: 阿好：我加兩蚊，熟客都照買，但係有啲客會行去隔籬。咁我算係 price taker 定 price searcher？
english: Ah Ho: When I add two dollars, my regulars still buy, but some customers go next door. So am I a price taker or a price searcher?

chinese_original: 阿婆：「大澳人口少咗」同「大澳應該保留棚屋」，你分唔分到邊句係事實，邊句係意見？
english: Granny: "Tai O's population has fallen" and "Tai O should keep its stilt houses": can you tell which is a fact and which is an opinion?

chinese_original: 阿婆：村民成日喺廟前傾偈，有人講事實，有人講意見。
english: Granny: Villagers are always chatting in front of the temple. Some state facts, some give opinions.

chinese_original: 阿強：Ch.6 我最熟！答啱 4 題先當你贏。
english: Ah Keung: Ch.6 is my thing! Get 4 right and you win.

chinese_original: 阿強：我喺五樓間五金廠做學師，成日幫老闆去打印仔、簽文件。
english: Ah Keung: I'm an apprentice at a hardware factory on the 5th floor, always running to get stamps made and documents signed for the boss.

chinese_original: 阿強：記住：sole proprietorship 同 partnership 都冇獨立法人地位，所以老闆要用私人財產還債。
english: Ah Keung: Remember: neither a sole proprietorship nor a partnership has separate legal status, so the owners must pay debts with their personal assets.

chinese_original: 阿德：Ch.7 擴張嘅嘢，我同你比 4 題！
english: Ah Tak: Ch.7 expansion stuff. Let's go 4 questions!

chinese_original: 阿德：我喺觀塘碼頭落貨，見住啲廠一間吞一間。
english: Ah Tak: I unload cargo at Kwun Tong pier and watch factories swallowing each other up one after another.

chinese_original: 阿德：買上游供應商係 backward，買落去賣自己貨嘅舖頭係 forward。次次問自己：邊個生產階段？
english: Ah Tak: Buying an upstream supplier is backward; buying the shops that sell your goods is forward. Always ask yourself: which stage of production?

chinese_original: 阿志：Ch.12 彈性，4 條定輸贏！
english: Ah Chi: Ch.12 elasticity. 4 questions decide it!

chinese_original: 阿志：demand elastic 就唔好亂加價，TR 會跌；inelastic 加價，TR 反而會升。
english: Ah Chi: If demand is elastic, don't raise prices carelessly, or TR falls; if it's inelastic, raising prices actually makes TR rise.
Ah Chi: Your sums are right.

chinese_original: 阿志：我喺廟街賣電筒同手錶，加價之前一定計清楚 elasticity。
english: Ah Chi: I sell torches and watches on Temple Street, and I always work out the elasticity before raising prices.

chinese_original: 阿忠：同樣係「做大咗」，但兩種做法喺經濟學入面叫法唔同。你分唔分到？
english: Ah Chung: Both are "growing bigger", but economics calls the two ways different things. Can you tell them apart?

chinese_original: 阿忠：我喺呢層做管工。1961 年，成個觀塘得大約 100 間廠、15,000 人；到 1985 年，有大約 7,000 間廠、200,000 人。
english: Ah Chung: I'm the foreman on this floor. In 1961, the whole of Kwun Tong had only about 100 factories and 15,000 workers; by 1985, there were about 7,000 factories and 200,000 workers.

chinese_original: 阿忠：老闆見生意好，一係自己加多兩層廠房，一係索性買起樓下間供應商。
english: Ah Chung: When business is good, the boss either adds two more floors of factory space himself, or just buys up the supplier downstairs.

chinese_original: 阿東：Ch.8 市場結構，答啱 4 題先當你贏！
english: Ah Tung: Ch.8 market structures. Get 4 right and you win!
Ah Tung: You can tell them apart!

chinese_original: 阿東：我喺金魚街幫手，一條街幾十間舖，賣嘅魚一樣，價錢都一樣。
english: Ah Tung: I help out on Goldfish Street. Dozens of shops on one street, selling the same fish at the same price.

chinese_original: 阿東：記住：賣家多唔等於 perfect competition，仲要產品同質、自由進出同資訊完全。
english: Ah Tung: Remember: many sellers doesn't mean perfect competition; you also need homogeneous products, free entry and exit, and perfect information.
Ah Yuk: Not bad, not bad.

chinese_original: 阿玉：我喺工廠車衣，按件計錢，快手先有錢！
english: Ah Yuk: I sew at a factory and get paid by the piece, so only fast hands make money!

chinese_original: 阿玉：答啱 4 條 Ch.4 題，先算你識！
english: Ah Yuk: Get 4 Ch.4 questions right and then I'll say you know your stuff!

chinese_original: 阿玉：計 labour productivity 要除以總工時，唔係除以人數；請多咗人唔代表 productivity 高咗。
english: Ah Yuk: To work out labour productivity, divide by total working hours, not by the number of workers; hiring more people doesn't mean productivity has gone up.

chinese_original: 阿玲：不過日日車同一個位好悶㗎。分工有好處，都有代價。你覺得有邊啲代價？
english: Ah Ling: But sewing the same spot every day gets really boring. Division of labour has benefits, but costs too. What costs can you think of?

chinese_original: 阿玲：工廠越大，分工越細：有人專車衣領、有人專車袖。好多工人按件計錢，咁老闆就唔使成日監住我哋有冇偷懶。
english: Ah Ling: The bigger the factory, the finer the division of labour: some only sew collars, some only sew sleeves. Lots of workers are paid by the piece, so the boss doesn't have to keep watching whether we're slacking.

chinese_original: 阿玲：我喺呢度做咗好多年車衣。高峰期，製衣業工人佔全港勞動人口大約一成半。
english: Ah Ling: I've been sewing here for many years. At its peak, the garment industry employed about 15% of Hong Kong's labour force.
Ah Chun: You really know your stuff!

chinese_original: 阿珍：分 positive 同 normative，問自己「可唔可以用事實推翻？」，唔好淨係睇有冇「應該」兩個字。
english: Ah Chun: To tell positive from normative, ask yourself "Can facts prove it wrong?", don't just look for the word "should".

chinese_original: 阿珍：嚟，用 Ch.2 題目比過，3 題定輸贏！
english: Ah Chun: Come on, let's compete with Ch.2 questions. 3 questions decide it!

chinese_original: 阿珍：我日日睇報紙，最識分事實同意見！
english: Ah Chun: I read the paper every day, so I'm the best at telling facts from opinions!
Ah Cheung: You really know production!

chinese_original: 阿祥：夠膽就答我 4 條 Ch.3 題！
english: Ah Cheung: Brave enough? Answer 4 Ch.3 questions!

chinese_original: 阿祥：我喺布檔幫手，日日見住布由織布廠去到製衣廠。
english: Ah Cheung: I help out at a fabric stall, and every day I see cloth go from weaving mills to garment factories.

chinese_original: 阿祥：送你一句：服務都係生產；幫客人剪布、送布都係 tertiary production。
english: Ah Cheung: A tip for you: services are production too; cutting and delivering cloth for customers is tertiary production.

chinese_original: 阿芬：我喺鹽田做學徒，日日都要計成本！
english: Ah Fun: I'm an apprentice at the salt pans, and I have to count costs every day!

chinese_original: 阿芬：答啱 4 題先贏到我。準備好未？
english: Ah Fun: Get 4 right to beat me. Ready?

chinese_original: 阿芬：記住：用自己時間都有成本，time cost 係嗰段時間最好嘅其他用途嘅價值，而且因人而異。
english: Ah Fun: Remember: your own time has a cost too. Time cost is the value of the best alternative use of that time, and it differs from person to person.
Ah Fun: I lost fair and square.

chinese_original: 阿詩：Ch.10 需求同供應，考你 4 題！
english: Ah Sze: Ch.10 demand and supply. 4 questions for you!

chinese_original: 阿詩：價錢低過 Pe 就有 shortage，成交量係 Qd 同 Qs 細嗰個；shortage 唔等於 scarcity。
english: Ah Sze: When the price is below Pe there's a shortage, and the quantity traded is the smaller of Qd and Qs; shortage is not the same as scarcity.

chinese_original: 阿詩：限量波鞋一出，條街排晒長龍。
english: Ah Sze: The moment limited-edition sneakers drop, the whole street is one long queue.

chinese_original: 阿財：Ch.16 政府干預同 deadweight loss，答啱 4 題先當你贏！
english: Ah Choi: Ch.16 government intervention and deadweight loss. Get 4 right and you win!

chinese_original: 阿財：政府一時限價、一時定最低價，我賣少咗，啲客又買唔到。
english: Ah Choi: One minute the government caps prices, the next it sets a minimum price. I sell less, and customers can't buy what they want.

chinese_original: 阿財：有效嘅上限、下限、配額，成交量都少過 Qe：under-production，有 deadweight loss。
english: Ah Choi: With an effective ceiling, floor or quota, the quantity traded is below Qe: under-production, with a deadweight loss.

chinese_original: 阿輝：喂！你都係捉 EconMon 㗎？我哋嚟比拼吓！
english: Ah Fai: Hey! You catch EconMon too? Let's battle!

chinese_original: 阿輝：我專捉紅樹林同沙灘嗰啲 Ch.1 EconMon。你答啱 3 題就算你贏！
english: Ah Fai: I catch Ch.1 EconMon in the mangroves and on the beach. Get 3 right and you win!

chinese_original: 阿輝：送你一句：opportunity cost 只計放棄咗嘅選擇入面最高價值嗰個，千祈唔好加埋。
english: Ah Fai: A tip for you: opportunity cost only counts the highest-valued option given up. Never add them together.

chinese_original: 限租、最低工資、配額、徵稅、補貼……政府一出手，價格同數量點變？邊個得益、邊個受損？社會嘅 total surplus 係多咗定少咗？
english: Rent control, minimum wage, quotas, taxes, subsidies... When the government steps in, how do price and quantity change? Who gains, who loses? Does society's total surplus rise or fall?

chinese_original: 陳伯：Ch.3 到 Ch.5 混埋一齊考你 5 題！
english: Uncle Chan: Ch.3 to Ch.5 mixed together: 5 questions for you!

chinese_original: 陳伯：好！可以去搵 May 姐喇。
english: Uncle Chan: Good! You can go and find Sister May now.

chinese_original: 陳伯：後生仔，我喺長沙灣工廠做咗幾十年師傅。
english: Uncle Chan: Young one, I've been a master craftsman at a Cheung Sha Wan factory for decades.

chinese_original: 陳伯：我喺紅磡租咗幾十年樓。香港以前有租金管制，到 1998 年 12 月 31 日先取消。（來源：立法會秘書處資料研究組）（陳伯係虛構人物）
english: Uncle Chan: I've rented a flat in Hung Hom for decades. Hong Kong used to have rent control; it was only abolished on 31 December 1998. (Source: Research Office, Legislative Council Secretariat) (Uncle Chan is a fictional character)

chinese_original: 陳伯：租管嗰陣租金低過市價，但係啲人話好難搵到樓租。你覺得出租單位少過 Qe，社會有冇損失？呢個損失叫咩？
english: Uncle Chan: Under rent control, rents were below market price, but people said it was hard to find a flat to rent. If rental units are fewer than Qe, does society lose out? What's that loss called?

chinese_original: 陳伯：記住：自己廠擴張慳成本係 internal economies；成個行業擴張令你慳成本係 external economies。
english: Uncle Chan: Remember: cost savings from your own firm expanding are internal economies; cost savings from the whole industry expanding are external economies.

chinese_original: 陳太：我請幫手嘅人工要升，有啲舖頭就少請咗人。你覺得最低工資係 price ceiling 定 price floor？會唔會出現勞工 surplus？
english: Mrs Chan: The wages I pay my helpers have to go up, and some shops have hired fewer people. Do you think the minimum wage is a price ceiling or a price floor? Will there be a labour surplus?

chinese_original: 陳姐：我人工係加咗。但老闆話，再加就要減人。你覺得 minimum wage 一定會收窄收入差距嗎？佢喺勞工市場係 price ceiling 定 price floor？
english: Sister Chan: My pay did go up. But the boss says any more and he'll cut staff. Do you think a minimum wage always narrows the income gap? Is it a price ceiling or a price floor in the labour market?

chinese_original: 陳師傅：Ch.6 同 Ch.7 溝埋考你 5 題！
english: Master Chan: Ch.6 and Ch.7 mixed together: 5 questions for you!

chinese_original: 陳師傅：好，去搵周老闆啦。
english: Master Chan: Good, go and find Boss Chow.

chinese_original: 陳師傅：我由深水埗車衣線做到觀塘工廈，見過好多老闆由細做到大。
english: Master Chan: I went from the sewing lines in Sham Shui Po to the industrial buildings in Kwun Tong, and I've seen lots of bosses grow from small to big.

chinese_original: 陳師傅：擴張唔係愈大愈好。管多幾門唔熟嘅生意，管理成本會升，就係 internal diseconomies of scale。
english: Master Chan: Bigger isn't always better. Take on a few businesses you don't know well and management costs rise: that's internal diseconomies of scale.

english: Uncle Lai: Ch.18, 19 and 20 mixed together: 5 questions for you!

chinese_original: 黎伯：可以去搵程小姐喇。
english: Uncle Lai: You can go and find Ms Ching now.

chinese_original: 黎伯：我喺中環做咗四十年數。
english: Uncle Lai: I've been doing the books in Central for forty years.

chinese_original: 黎伯：數字唔會呃人，但睇錯數字就會呃自己：分清份額同金額、nominal 同 real、GDP 同 GNI。
english: Uncle Lai: Numbers don't lie, but misreading them fools yourself: tell shares from amounts, nominal from real, GDP from GNI.
