chinese_original: 大澳・深水埗・觀塘・旺角・油麻地・石硤尾・紅磡・中環 · Ch.1–20 · 模擬試場 I–III · PVP · 0.19
english: Tai O・Sham Shui Po・Kwun Tong・Mong Kok・Yau Ma Tei・Shek Kip Mei・Hung Hom・Central · Ch.1–20 · Mock Exam Hall I–III · PVP · 0.19

chinese_original: 0 至 1 之間嘅一個數字
A market economy mainly uses the market mechanism (or price system) to solve the three basic economic problems。Market price 係分配資源嘅訊號；資源主要由私人擁有。
english: A market economy mainly uses the market mechanism (or price system) to solve the three basic economic problems. Market price is the signal for allocating resources; resources are mainly privately owned.

chinese_original: A planned economy (or command economy) mainly uses government commands to solve the three basic economic problems。資源主要由 the state 擁有，決策主要由政府做。
english: A planned economy (or command economy) mainly uses government commands to solve the three basic economic problems. Resources are mainly owned by the state, and decisions are mainly made by the government.

chinese_original: A traditional economy mainly uses customs and traditions to solve the three basic economic problems。
english: A traditional economy mainly uses customs and traditions to solve the three basic economic problems.

chinese_original: AP = TP ÷ variable factor 單位；MP(n) = TP(n) − TP(n−1)；MP > AP 時 AP 上升，MP < AP 時 AP 下降。
english: AP = TP ÷ units of variable factor; MP(n) = TP(n) − TP(n−1); when MP > AP, AP rises; when MP < AP, AP falls.

chinese_original: Consumer surplus（CS）= TB − TE = 每個買咗嘅單位 (MB − P) 加埋；即係 demand curve 以下、價格以上嘅面積。價格下跌，CS 增加。
english: Consumer surplus (CS) = TB − TE = the sum of (MB − P) for every unit bought; i.e. the area below the demand curve and above the price. When price falls, CS increases.

chinese_original: Demand：喺唔同價格下，買家喺一段時間內願意而且有能力購買嘅數量（有購買力支持嘅 wants，係一個計劃）。價格改變只係沿住同一條 demand curve 改變 quantity demanded。Market demand = 個人 demand 嘅 horizontal summation（將數量相加）。
english: Demand: the quantities buyers are willing and able to buy at different prices over a period of time (wants backed by purchasing power; it is a plan). A price change only causes a movement along the same demand curve, changing quantity demanded. Market demand = the horizontal summation of individual demand (adding up the quantities).

chinese_original: D↑：Pe↑ Qe↑；D↓：Pe↓ Qe↓；S↑：Pe↓ Qe↑；S↓：Pe↑ Qe↓。兩條線同時移：D↑S↑ → Qe↑、Pe 不確定；D↑S↓ → Pe↑、Qe 不確定（除非知道移動幅度）。
english: D↑: Pe↑ Qe↑; D↓: Pe↓ Qe↓; S↑: Pe↓ Qe↑; S↓: Pe↑ Qe↓. Both curves shift together: D↑S↑ → Qe↑, Pe uncertain; D↑S↓ → Pe↑, Qe uncertain (unless the size of the shifts is known).

chinese_original: Economic good：數量唔夠滿足所有人、more is preferred、人願意付價錢競爭、有 production cost。Free good：數量夠滿足所有人、more is not preferred、冇人願意俾錢、冇 production cost。
english: Economic good: quantity not enough to satisfy everyone, more is preferred, people are willing to pay a price to compete for it, has a production cost. Free good: quantity enough to satisfy everyone, more is not preferred, nobody is willing to pay for it, no production cost.

chinese_original: Ed = %ΔQd ÷ %ΔP（取絕對值）。Arc method 用兩點嘅平均值計百分比：%ΔQ = (Q2 − Q1) ÷ [(Q1 + Q2)/2]。
english: Ed = %ΔQd ÷ %ΔP (take the absolute value). The arc method uses the average of the two points to calculate percentages: %ΔQ = (Q2 − Q1) ÷ [(Q1 + Q2)/2].

chinese_original: Ed（取絕對值）> 1 elastic；< 1 inelastic；= 1 unitary elastic；= 0 perfectly inelastic（垂直）；= ∞ perfectly elastic（水平）。直線 demand curve 斜率不變，但 Ed 沿線改變：slope ≠ elasticity。
english: Ed (absolute value) > 1 elastic; < 1 inelastic; = 1 unitary elastic; = 0 perfectly inelastic (vertical); = ∞ perfectly elastic (horizontal). A straight-line demand curve has a constant slope, but Ed changes along the line: slope ≠ elasticity.

chinese_original: Elastic：價格同 TR 反方向；inelastic：同方向；unitary：TR 不變。減價只會喺 demand elastic 時增加 TR。
english: Elastic: price and TR move in opposite directions; inelastic: same direction; unitary: TR unchanged. Cutting price only increases TR when demand is elastic.

chinese_original: Es = %ΔQs ÷ %ΔP。時間越長、生產要素越易轉移、有剩餘產能或存貨、容易入行 → supply 越 elastic。新鮮生果唔可以儲，極短期 Es 好低。
english: Es = %ΔQs ÷ %ΔP. The longer the time, the easier factors of production move, the more spare capacity or stock, the easier it is to enter the industry → the more elastic the supply. Fresh fruit cannot be stored, so Es is very low in the very short run.

chinese_original: Exchange can take place with or without the use of money（barter）。Specialisation：不同人或經濟體專注生產不同物品或同一物品嘅不同生產階段。Private property rights enable exchange；exchange enables specialisation。
english: Exchange can take place with or without the use of money (barter). Specialisation: different people or economies concentrate on producing different goods, or different stages of production of the same good. Private property rights enable exchange; exchange enables specialisation.

chinese_original: Expenditure approach：GDP = C + I + G + (X − M)。I = gross domestic fixed capital formation + changes in inventories；G 唔包括 transfer payments；減 M 因為 C、I、G、X 已經包咗進口嘢。買二手樓或者股票唔係 GDP 入面嘅 investment。
english: Expenditure approach: GDP = C + I + G + (X − M). I = gross domestic fixed capital formation + changes in inventories; G excludes transfer payments; M is subtracted because C, I, G and X already include imported goods. Buying second-hand flats or shares is not investment in GDP.

chinese_original: Fixed cost 改變會改變總 profit，但唔會改變 profit 最大化嘅產量，因為 fixed cost 唔影響 MC。
english: A change in fixed cost changes total profit, but not the profit-maximising output, because fixed cost does not affect MC.

chinese_original: Full cost = money cost + non-money cost。Money cost 係所揀選項嘅金錢開支；non-money cost 係所用非金錢資源（例如時間）嘅最佳其他用途嘅價值。
english: Full cost = money cost + non-money cost. Money cost is the money spent on the chosen option; non-money cost is the value of the best alternative use of the non-money resources used (e.g. time).

chinese_original: Full price = money price + non-money price（例如排隊時間）。Relative price = 一件物品以另一件物品表示嘅價格。兩件物品嘅 money price 加同一個數，貴嗰件嘅 relative price 會下降。
english: Full price = money price + non-money price (e.g. queuing time). Relative price = the price of one good expressed in terms of another good. If the same amount is added to the money prices of two goods, the relative price of the dearer one falls.

chinese_original: GDP deflator = nominal GDP ÷ real GDP × 100，包括本地生產嘅所有物品同服務（包括資本財同出口，唔包括進口），籃子隨產出變動。CPI 用固定籃子，只包括住戶消費品（包括進口消費品）。
english: GDP deflator = nominal GDP ÷ real GDP × 100. It covers all goods and services produced locally (including capital goods and exports, excluding imports), and its basket changes with output. CPI uses a fixed basket and covers only household consumer goods (including imported consumer goods).

chinese_original: GDP：一段時間內，經濟體系內所有 resident producing units 生產嘅所有最終物品同服務嘅市場價值。GDP 係 flow，唔係 stock；睇生產喺邊度、由邊個 resident 生產，唔睇老闆國籍。有薪家務助理嘅服務計入 GDP，自己做家務就唔計。
english: GDP: the market value of all final goods and services produced by all resident producing units in an economy over a period of time. GDP is a flow, not a stock; it looks at where production happens and which resident produces it, not the owner's nationality. The services of a paid domestic helper count in GDP; doing your own housework does not.

chinese_original: GNI = GDP + net external factor income（居民喺外地賺嘅要素收入 − 非居民喺本地賺嘅要素收入）。Transfer payments、二手貨（只計經紀佣金）、樓價同股價升值、純金融交易都唔計入 GDP。
english: GNI = GDP + net external factor income (factor income earned abroad by residents − factor income earned locally by non-residents). Transfer payments, second-hand goods (only the broker's commission counts), rises in property and share prices, and purely financial transactions are not counted in GDP.

chinese_original: Gini coefficient = A ÷ (A + B)，A 係對角線同 Lorenz curve 之間嘅面積，B 係曲線下面嘅面積。數值由 0（完全平均）到 1（完全唔平均），越大越唔平均。佢只睇收入分配，唔反映生活水平高低，同一個數值亦可以嚟自唔同嘅分配。
english: Gini coefficient = A ÷ (A + B), where A is the area between the diagonal and the Lorenz curve and B is the area under the curve. It ranges from 0 (perfect equality) to 1 (perfect inequality); the larger it is, the more unequal. It only looks at income distribution, does not reflect the standard of living, and the same value can come from different distributions.

chinese_original: Goods 係有形（tangible），services 係無形（intangible）。按用途分：直接滿足 wants 嘅係 consumer goods；用嚟生產其他物品嘅係 producer（capital）goods，同一件物品可以兩樣都係。
english: Goods are tangible; services are intangible. By use: those that directly satisfy wants are consumer goods; those used to produce other goods are producer (capital) goods, and the same item can be both.

chinese_original: Horizontal expansion：擴張到生產同一種產品、或者處於同一生產階段嘅業務。可以係 internal（自己開多幾間同類分店）或 external（同同行合併／收購）。External horizontal expansion 仲可以減少競爭對手。
english: Horizontal expansion: expanding into businesses producing the same product or at the same stage of production. It can be internal (opening more branches of the same kind) or external (merging with / acquiring a rival). External horizontal expansion also reduces competitors.

chinese_original: Households 喺 factor market 提供 factor services，收取 factor income；firms 喺 product market 提供 goods and services，收取 households' expenditure。Real flow：factor services、goods and services；money flow：money income、money expenditure。
english: Households provide factor services in the factor market and receive factor income; firms provide goods and services in the product market and receive households' expenditure. Real flow: factor services, goods and services; money flow: money income, money expenditure.

chinese_original: Income approach：GDP at factor cost = 僱員報酬 + gross operating surplus（租金、利息、利潤、折舊）。GDP at market prices = GDP at factor cost + indirect taxes − subsidies。
english: Income approach: GDP at factor cost = compensation of employees + gross operating surplus (rent, interest, profits, depreciation). GDP at market prices = GDP at factor cost + indirect taxes − subsidies.

chinese_original: Internal expansion：廠商靠自己擴大生產規模（加廠房、加機器、加人手、開分店），冇第二間廠商參與。External expansion：同另一間廠商結合——merger（合併成一間）或 acquisition／takeover（買夠股份控制另一間）。
english: Internal expansion: a firm enlarges its scale of production on its own (more plants, machines, staff, branches) with no other firm involved. External expansion: combining with another firm — merger (becoming one firm) or acquisition / takeover (buying enough shares to control the other).

chinese_original: Labour productivity = total output ÷ total number of working hours（每工時產量），唔係每個工人嘅產量。
english: Labour productivity = total output ÷ total number of working hours (output per man-hour), not output per worker.

chinese_original: Labour supply = 總工作時數（man-hours）= 工人數目 × 每人平均工作時數，唔係以人頭計。
english: Labour supply = total working hours (man-hours) = number of workers × average working hours per worker, not a headcount.

chinese_original: Labour supply 用 man-hours；productivity 係每工時產量
english: Labour supply uses man-hours; productivity is output per man-hour

chinese_original: Labour（wages）、capital（interest）、land（rent）、entrepreneurship（profits）。Land 創造冇成本但使用有成本，供應唔可以靠人力增加但唔係固定。Capital formation > capital depreciation → capital accumulation。
english: Labour (wages), capital (interest), land (rent), entrepreneurship (profits). Land is created at no cost but is costly to use; its supply cannot be increased by human effort, yet it is not fixed. Capital formation > capital depreciation → capital accumulation.

chinese_original: Lateral expansion：擴張到有關連但唔直接競爭嘅產品。Conglomerate expansion：擴張到完全唔相關嘅行業。兩者都可以 diversify，分散風險。
english: Lateral expansion: expanding into related products that do not compete directly. Conglomerate expansion: expanding into completely unrelated industries. Both allow a firm to diversify and spread risk.

chinese_original: Limited company 係 incorporated：有獨立法人地位（separate legal entity）、perpetual succession，股東 liability 只限於未繳足嘅股本。Private ltd 最多 50 個股東、股份轉讓受限；public ltd 股東數目冇上限、可以公開招股。
english: A limited company is incorporated: it is a separate legal entity with perpetual succession, and shareholders' liability is limited to their unpaid share capital. A private ltd has at most 50 shareholders and restricted share transfer; a public ltd has no limit on shareholders and can offer shares to the public.

chinese_original: Lorenz curve：橫軸係由最窮排起嘅住戶累積百分比，縱軸係佢哋所佔收入嘅累積百分比。對角線係 line of perfect equality；條曲線越彎、離對角線越遠，收入分配就越唔平均。
english: Lorenz curve: the horizontal axis is the cumulative percentage of households ranked from the poorest; the vertical axis is the cumulative percentage of income they receive. The diagonal is the line of perfect equality; the more the curve bends away from the diagonal, the more unequal the income distribution.

chinese_original: MC = 多生產一單位帶嚟嘅 TC 變化
english: MC = the change in TC from producing one more unit

chinese_original: MP = 多一個工人帶嚟嘅 TP 變化
english: MP = the change in TP from one more worker

chinese_original: Marginal benefit（MB）係消費者為多一單位最多願意付嘅錢，通常遞減。Demand curve 就係 MB curve。Total benefit（TB）= 所有已消費單位嘅 MB 加埋。
english: Marginal benefit (MB) is the most a consumer is willing to pay for one more unit, and it usually diminishes. The demand curve is the MB curve. Total benefit (TB) = the sum of the MB of all units consumed.

chinese_original: May 姐：以下全部數字都係虛構練習題。答啱我六條問題，先拎到車衣徽章！
english: Sister May: All the numbers below are made up for practice. Answer my six questions correctly to earn the Sewing Badge!

chinese_original: May 姐：你媽媽都喺我條線度車衣。想明白工廠點運作，就要識分工、生產要素同成本。
english: Sister May: Your Mum sews on my line too. To understand how a factory runs, you need to know division of labour, factors of production and costs.

chinese_original: May 姐：你就係福伯個孫？我喺呢間製衣廠做拉長，睇住成條車衣線。
english: Sister May: So you're Grandpa Fuk's grandson? I'm the line leader at this garment factory, in charge of the whole sewing line.

chinese_original: May 姐：你已經學完 Ch.3–5，下一步可以去考場試吓身手喇！
english: Sister May: You've finished Ch.3–5. Next, go and try your hand at the exam hall!

chinese_original: May 姐：好嘢！你睇得明成間廠點運作。
english: Sister May: Great job! You understand how the whole factory works.

chinese_original: May 姐：拎住車衣徽章。記住：工人唔係機器，分工有好處都有代價。
english: Sister May: Take the Sewing Badge. Remember: workers aren't machines — division of labour has benefits and costs.

chinese_original: Monopolistic competition：好多賣家、產品有差異（differentiated）、入行障礙低、大量 non-price competition（包裝、服務、地點、廣告）；每個賣家係有少少定價能力嘅 price searcher。
english: Monopolistic competition: many sellers, differentiated products, low barriers to entry, lots of non-price competition (packaging, service, location, advertising); each seller is a price searcher with a little pricing power.

chinese_original: Monopoly：唯一賣家、冇相近替代品、入行障礙極高。來源：政府專營／法定授權、franchise、natural monopoly、patent／copyright、獨佔關鍵資源、合謀或合併。Monopolist 仍然面對向下傾斜嘅 demand curve。
english: Monopoly: a single seller, no close substitutes, very high barriers to entry. Sources: government monopoly / statutory authorisation, franchise, natural monopoly, patent / copyright, sole control of key resources, collusion or merger. A monopolist still faces a downward-sloping demand curve.

chinese_original: Negative externality：生產或消費令第三者承受成本，但唔使賠償。Social cost = private cost + external cost，即 MSC = MPC + MEC。市場只睇 MPC，所以會 over-production。
english: Negative externality: production or consumption imposes a cost on third parties without compensation. Social cost = private cost + external cost, i.e. MSC = MPC + MEC. The market only considers MPC, so there is over-production.

chinese_original: No choice implies no cost。Historical cost is not a cost：已經付咗、無論點揀都拎唔返。
english: No choice implies no cost. Historical cost is not a cost: it has already been paid and cannot be recovered whatever you choose.

chinese_original: Nominal GDP 用當期價格計；real GDP 用基期價格計，剔走價格變動嘅影響。Real GDP = nominal GDP ÷ GDP deflator × 100。Nominal GDP 上升，可能只係物價升，產量未必多咗。
english: Nominal GDP is measured at current prices; real GDP is measured at base-year prices, removing the effect of price changes. Real GDP = nominal GDP ÷ GDP deflator × 100. A rise in nominal GDP may just be rising prices, not necessarily more output.

chinese_original: Normal good：收入增加 → demand 增加；inferior good：收入增加 → demand 減少。預期將來加價 → 而家 demand 增加。買家數目、喜好都會令 demand curve 移動。
english: Normal good: income rises → demand increases; inferior good: income rises → demand decreases. Expecting future price rises → demand increases now. The number of buyers and tastes also shift the demand curve.

chinese_original: Occupational mobility：轉職業嘅意願同容易程度；geographical mobility：轉工作地點嘅意願同容易程度。
english: Occupational mobility: the willingness and ease of changing occupation; geographical mobility: the willingness and ease of changing workplace location.

chinese_original: Oligopoly：少數幾個佔主導地位（dominant）嘅賣家（細賣家可以存在）、入行障礙高、決策互相依賴（interdependence）、價格傾向僵硬、常用 non-price competition。
english: Oligopoly: a few dominant sellers (small sellers may exist), high barriers to entry, interdependence in decision-making, prices tend to be rigid, frequent non-price competition.

chinese_original: P < Pe：Qd > Qs，excess demand（shortage），成交量 Qt = Qs，價格傾向上升。P > Pe：Qs > Qd，excess supply（surplus），Qt = Qd，價格傾向下跌。Shortage 唔等於 scarcity。
english: P < Pe: Qd > Qs, excess demand (shortage), quantity transacted Qt = Qs, price tends to rise. P > Pe: Qs > Qd, excess supply (surplus), Qt = Qd, price tends to fall. Shortage is not the same as scarcity.

chinese_original: Per capita GDP = GDP ÷ 人口。Growth rate =（今年 − 去年）÷ 去年 × 100%。比較唔同人口嘅經濟體系要用 per capita，睇生活水平變化要用 real per capita GDP。
english: Per capita GDP = GDP ÷ population. Growth rate = (this year − last year) ÷ last year × 100%. Use per capita figures to compare economies with different populations, and real per capita GDP to see changes in living standards.

chinese_original: Perfect competition 下 supply curve 就係 MC curve。Producer surplus（PS）= TR − TVC = 每單位 (P − MC) 加埋 = profit + TFC；即係價格以下、supply curve 以上嘅面積。PS 唔等於 profit。
english: Under perfect competition, the supply curve is the MC curve. Producer surplus (PS) = TR − TVC = the sum of (P − MC) for each unit = profit + TFC; i.e. the area below the price and above the supply curve. PS is not the same as profit.

chinese_original: Perfect competition 入面 price taker 嘅 MR = P。只要 MR ≥ MC 就多生產一單位；profit 最大化嘅產量喺 MR = MC（即 P = MC）。
english: In perfect competition, a price taker's MR = P. Produce one more unit as long as MR ≥ MC; profit is maximised at the output where MR = MC (i.e. P = MC).

chinese_original: Perfect competition：好多細小賣家、產品同質（homogeneous）、自由進出、市場資訊完全；每個賣家都係 price taker。現實世界唔存在，只有近似嘅市場。
english: Perfect competition: many small sellers, homogeneous products, free entry and exit, perfect market information; every seller is a price taker. It does not exist in the real world; only approximate markets do.

chinese_original: Piece rate（按件）、time rate（按時間）、commission（銷售收入嘅一部分）、profit-sharing（利潤嘅一部分）、tips（客人俾嘅打賞）。
english: Piece rate (per piece), time rate (per unit of time), commission (a share of sales revenue), profit-sharing (a share of profits), tips (gratuities from customers).

chinese_original: Positive externality：生產或消費令第三者得益，但唔使俾錢。Social benefit = private benefit + external benefit，即 MSB = MPB + MEB。市場只睇 MPB，所以會 under-production。
english: Positive externality: production or consumption benefits third parties without them paying. Social benefit = private benefit + external benefit, i.e. MSB = MPB + MEB. The market only considers MPB, so there is under-production.

chinese_original: Positive statements are statements about facts. They can be refuted by facts。Normative statements are statements about value judgements. They cannot be refuted by facts。
english: Positive statements are statements about facts. They can be refuted by facts. Normative statements are statements about value judgements. They cannot be refuted by facts.

chinese_original: Price ceiling 係法定最高價格。要定喺 equilibrium price 以下先有效：價格下降、出現 shortage（Qd > Qs），成交量 Qt = Qs，比原本少。
english: A price ceiling is a legal maximum price. It is only effective when set below the equilibrium price: price falls, a shortage appears (Qd > Qs), and quantity transacted Qt = Qs, less than before.

chinese_original: Price ceiling 定喺 Pe 或以上、price floor 定喺 Pe 或以下都係 ineffective，市場唔受影響。有效 price floor 下賣家 TR 點變睇 Ed：demand elastic → TR 跌；inelastic → TR 升。
english: A price ceiling set at or above Pe, or a price floor set at or below Pe, is ineffective and the market is unaffected. Under an effective price floor, how sellers' TR changes depends on Ed: demand elastic → TR falls; inelastic → TR rises.

chinese_original: Price floor 係法定最低價格。要定喺 equilibrium price 以上先有效：價格上升、出現 surplus（Qs > Qd），Qt = Qd。Minimum wage 係勞工市場嘅 price floor，高過市場工資就會出現勞工過剩（失業）。
english: A price floor is a legal minimum price. It is only effective when set above the equilibrium price: price rises, a surplus appears (Qs > Qd), Qt = Qd. A minimum wage is a price floor in the labour market; if it is above the market wage, there is a surplus of labour (unemployment).

chinese_original: Price index = 當期價格 ÷ 基期價格 × 100，基期 = 100。CPI 量度住戶一籃子消費品同服務嘅價格變動，權數嚟自住戶開支統計調查。香港編製 CPI(A)、CPI(B)、CPI(C) 同 Composite CPI。Inflation rate =（今期 CPI − 上期 CPI）÷ 上期 CPI × 100%。
english: Price index = current price ÷ base-period price × 100, with base period = 100. CPI measures price changes of a household basket of consumer goods and services, with weights from the Household Expenditure Survey. Hong Kong compiles CPI(A), CPI(B), CPI(C) and the Composite CPI. Inflation rate = (current CPI − previous CPI) ÷ previous CPI × 100%.

chinese_original: Price taker 只可以接受市場價格；price searcher 面對向下傾斜嘅 demand curve，加價會流失部分（唔係全部）顧客。Price competition 靠減價；non-price competition 靠產品、服務、地點同宣傳。
english: A price taker can only accept the market price; a price searcher faces a downward-sloping demand curve and loses some (not all) customers when raising price. Price competition relies on price cuts; non-price competition relies on product, service, location and promotion.

chinese_original: Primary production 直接由大自然攞資源；secondary production 將原料變成半製成品或製成品（包括建造）；tertiary production 提供服務。
english: Primary production takes resources directly from nature; secondary production turns raw materials into semi-finished or finished goods (including construction); tertiary production provides services.

chinese_original: Private firms 主要目標係 profit maximisation；public enterprises 可以以社會目標為先，定低價甚至免費。但政府資源仍然有 opportunity cost，而且缺少利潤誘因同競爭，效率可能較低。
english: The main goal of private firms is profit maximisation; public enterprises may put social goals first and set low prices or even provide things free. But government resources still have an opportunity cost, and without profit incentives and competition, efficiency may be lower.

chinese_original: Private goods：rival（一個人用咗會減少其他人可用嘅數量）同 excludable（排除唔俾錢嘅人成本唔高）。Public goods：non-rival 同 non-excludable。分類睇性質，唔係睇邊個提供、收唔收錢。
english: Private goods: rival (one person's use reduces the amount available to others) and excludable (the cost of excluding non-payers is not high). Public goods: non-rival and non-excludable. Classification depends on the nature of the good, not on who provides it or whether a charge is made.

chinese_original: Private property rights refer to the exclusive right to use, the exclusive right to receive income from, and the right to transfer a private property。
english: Private property rights refer to the exclusive right to use, the exclusive right to receive income from, and the right to transfer a private property.

chinese_original: Production approach：value added = 產出價值 − intermediate consumption。將所有 RPU 嘅 value added 加埋就係 GDP。只計 final goods 同計晒每個階段嘅 value added 會得出同一個數，咁先唔會 double counting。
english: Production approach: value added = value of output − intermediate consumption. Adding up the value added of all RPUs gives GDP. Counting only final goods and counting the value added at every stage give the same figure, which avoids double counting.

chinese_original: Production：turning inputs into output；exchange：買賣或以物易物；consumption：the activity to satisfy human wants directly。Firms 係 production units，households 係 consumption units。
english: Production: turning inputs into output; exchange: buying and selling or bartering; consumption: the activity to satisfy human wants directly. Firms are production units; households are consumption units.

chinese_original: Public enterprise 係政府全資擁有嘅企業。Government department 由政府部門直接經營，員工係公務員；public corporation 由法例成立，有獨立董事局，員工唔係公務員，日常運作較獨立。
english: A public enterprise is a business wholly owned by the government. A government department is run directly by the government and its staff are civil servants; a public corporation is set up by law with an independent board of directors, its staff are not civil servants, and its daily operations are more independent.

chinese_original: Qd = Qs 嘅價格係 equilibrium price（Pe），對應數量係 equilibrium quantity（Qe）；喺呢點價格冇改變嘅傾向。
english: The price at which Qd = Qs is the equilibrium price (Pe), and the corresponding quantity is the equilibrium quantity (Qe); at this point the price has no tendency to change.

chinese_original: Qd 同 Qs 唔相等
english: Qd and Qs are not equal

chinese_original: Quota 係法定最高數量。要定喺 equilibrium quantity 以下先有效：supply curve 喺配額數量變垂直（kinked），價格上升、數量減少；持有配額嘅人賺到額外收入（quota rights 有價值），質素可能提高。
english: A quota is a legal maximum quantity. It is only effective if set below the equilibrium quantity: the supply curve becomes vertical at the quota quantity (kinked), price rises and quantity falls; quota holders earn extra income (quota rights have value), and quality may rise.

chinese_original: Scarcity → competition → discrimination。Competition 決定邊個得到物品同得到幾多；輸咗嘅人被 discriminated against。Price competition 以價格做準則；non-price competition 用其他準則。
english: Scarcity → competition → discrimination. Competition decides who gets the goods and how much; the losers are discriminated against. Price competition uses price as the criterion; non-price competition uses other criteria.

chinese_original: Share = 擁有權，持有人係 owner，收 dividend（有盈利先派），清盤時最後先攞得返錢。Bond／debenture = 借貸，持有人係 creditor，收固定 interest（蝕錢都要俾），清盤時排喺股東之前。發新股增加 equity capital，發債增加 debt。
english: Share = ownership: the holder is an owner, receives dividends (paid only when there is profit) and is repaid last on liquidation. Bond/debenture = borrowing: the holder is a creditor, receives fixed interest (payable even at a loss) and ranks ahead of shareholders on liquidation. Issuing new shares increases equity capital; issuing bonds increases debt.

chinese_original: Short run 入面，不斷將 variable factor 加落固定數量嘅 fixed factors，variable factor 嘅 MP 最終會下降（technology 不變）。
english: In the short run, as more of a variable factor is added to a fixed quantity of fixed factors, the MP of the variable factor will eventually fall (technology unchanged).

chinese_original: Short run：最少有一種 fixed factor；long run：所有生產要素都係 variable。唔係按日曆長短分。
english: Short run: at least one fixed factor; long run: all factors of production are variable. It is not about calendar time.

chinese_original: Simple：唔同工人專門生產唔同物品；complex：唔同工人專門做同一物品嘅唔同工序；regional：唔同地區專門生產唔同物品或工序。
english: Simple: different workers specialise in producing different goods; complex: different workers specialise in different processes of the same good; regional: different regions specialise in different goods or processes.

chinese_original: Sole proprietorship 同 partnership 都係 unincorporated business：冇獨立法人地位，東主／合夥人負 unlimited liability，企業壽命跟住東主。Partnership 一般 2–20 人。
english: Sole proprietorships and partnerships are both unincorporated businesses: no separate legal entity, the owner/partners bear unlimited liability, and the business's life follows the owner's. A partnership generally has 2–20 people.

chinese_original: Substitutes（competitive demand）：替代品加價 → 呢件貨嘅 demand 增加。Complements（joint demand）：互補品加價 → demand 減少。Derived demand：對生產要素嘅 demand 嚟自對產品嘅 demand。
english: Substitutes (competitive demand): a substitute's price rises → demand for this good increases. Complements (joint demand): a complement's price rises → demand falls. Derived demand: demand for a factor of production comes from demand for the product.

chinese_original: Supply：喺唔同價格下，賣家喺一段時間內願意而且有能力出售嘅數量。Law of supply：ceteris paribus，價格越高，quantity supplied 越大。Market supply 同樣係 horizontal summation。
english: Supply: the quantities sellers are willing and able to sell at different prices over a period of time. Law of supply: ceteris paribus, the higher the price, the larger the quantity supplied. Market supply is likewise a horizontal summation.

chinese_original: TC = TFC + TVC；AC = TC ÷ Q；MC = TC(x) − TC(x−1) = TVC(x) − TVC(x−1)。Fixed cost 改變唔影響 MC。
english: TC = TFC + TVC; AC = TC ÷ Q; MC = TC(x) − TC(x−1) = TVC(x) − TVC(x−1). A change in fixed cost does not affect MC.

chinese_original: TR = P × Q；profit = TR − TC。TR 最大唔等於 profit 最大。
english: TR = P × Q; profit = TR − TC. Maximum TR does not mean maximum profit.

chinese_original: TVC = 每一單位 MC 嘅總和；TC = TFC + TVC；AC = TC ÷ Q。由 MC 欄可以砌返 TVC、TC 同 profit。
english: TVC = sum of the MC of every unit; TC = TFC + TVC; AC = TC ÷ Q. From the MC column you can rebuild TVC, TC and profit.

chinese_original: Tax incidence：邊一方嘅 elasticity 較低，就負擔較多稅款。Demand perfectly inelastic → 消費者負擔全部；demand perfectly elastic → 生產者負擔全部。消費者負擔 = 付價升幅；生產者負擔 = 淨價跌幅。
english: Tax incidence: the side with lower elasticity bears more of the tax. Demand perfectly inelastic → consumers bear all of it; demand perfectly elastic → producers bear all of it. Consumers' burden = rise in price paid; producers' burden = fall in net price.

chinese_original: Time cost is the value of the best alternative use of time。Time cost 因人而異。
english: Time cost is the value of the best alternative use of time. Time cost differs from person to person.

chinese_original: Total social surplus（TSS）= CS + PS = Σ(MB − MC)。TSS 最大 = efficiency，即係生產到 MB = MC 嘅數量。Efficient 唔等於 equitable（公平）。
english: Total social surplus (TSS) = CS + PS = Σ(MB − MC). Maximum TSS = efficiency, i.e. producing the quantity where MB = MC. Efficient does not mean equitable (fair).

chinese_original: Under-production（Q < Q*）：少咗嘅單位 MB > MC；over-production（Q > Q*）：多出嘅單位 MC > MB。兩者都令 TSS 減少，減少嘅部分叫 deadweight loss。價格有 rationing function（決定邊個得到貨品）同 allocative function（引導資源用途）。
english: Under-production (Q < Q*): for the missing units MB > MC; over-production (Q > Q*): for the extra units MC > MB. Both reduce TSS, and the reduction is called deadweight loss. Price has a rationing function (deciding who gets the goods) and an allocative function (guiding resource use).

chinese_original: Unit subsidy 令成交量增加到 Qe 以上，多出嚟嗰啲單位 MC > MB，係 over-production，有 deadweight loss。CS 同 PS 都增加，但政府補貼開支大過兩者增幅，TSS = CS + PS − subsidy expenditure，TSS 減少。
english: A unit subsidy raises the quantity transacted above Qe; for the extra units MC > MB, which is over-production with a deadweight loss. CS and PS both increase, but the government's subsidy spending exceeds their combined increase: TSS = CS + PS − subsidy expenditure, so TSS falls.

chinese_original: Unit tax 令成交量減少，係 under-production。有稅嘅時候 TSS = CS + PS + tax revenue；稅收只係由買賣雙方轉移去政府，唔係損失。真正嘅損失係 deadweight loss 三角形。Demand 或 supply 越 elastic，DWL 越大。
english: A unit tax reduces the quantity transacted, which is under-production. With a tax, TSS = CS + PS + tax revenue; tax revenue is only transferred from buyers and sellers to the government, not lost. The real loss is the deadweight loss triangle. The more elastic demand or supply is, the larger the DWL.

chinese_original: Vertical expansion：擴張到同一產品嘅較早或較後生產階段。Backward（向後）= 擴去上游，確保原料供應穩定；forward（向前）= 擴去下游，確保產品有銷售出路。
english: Vertical expansion: expanding into an earlier or later stage of production of the same product. Backward = expanding upstream to secure a stable supply of raw materials; forward = expanding downstream to secure sales outlets for products.

chinese_original: What to produce（生產咩、幾多）、how to produce（用咩生產方法）、for whom to produce（用咩準則決定邊個享用）。
english: What to produce (what and how much), how to produce (which production method), for whom to produce (which criteria decide who enjoys it).

chinese_original: demand vs quantity demanded、law of demand、market demand
english: demand vs quantity demanded, law of demand, market demand

chinese_original: demand 以下、價格以上嘅面積
english: Area below demand and above price

chinese_original: elastic：價格同 TR 反方向
english: elastic: price and TR move in opposite directions

chinese_original: goods vs services、consumer vs producer goods
english: goods vs services, consumer vs producer goods

chinese_original: households 喺 factor market 提供 factor services
english: households provide factor services in the factor market
limited company, limited liability, separate legal entity

chinese_original: man-hours = 工人數目 × 平均工時
english: man-hours = number of workers × average working hours

chinese_original: money flow 同 real flow 方向相反
english: money flow and real flow move in opposite directions
no choice no cost, historical cost

chinese_original: over-production：Q 升到 Qe 以上
price taker vs price searcher、price vs non-price competition
english: price taker vs price searcher, price vs non-price competition

chinese_original: private sector vs public sector、aims and efficiency
english: private sector vs public sector, aims and efficiency

chinese_original: public enterprise：government department vs public corporation
english: public enterprise: government department vs public corporation

chinese_original: short run vs long run、fixed vs variable factors
english: short run vs long run, fixed vs variable factors
simple, complex, regional division of labour

chinese_original: supply vs quantity supplied、law of supply
english: supply vs quantity supplied, law of supply

chinese_original: supply 向上移，距離等於金額
english: Supply shifts up by a distance equal to the amount
Supply turns vertical at the limit

chinese_original: under-production：Q 跌到 Qe 以下
x 軸 = 住戶累積百分比
− 付俾非居民嘅要素收入

english: One district weaves cloth, another sews garments

chinese_original: 一般假設廠商追求 profit maximisation；其他目標包括 market share、corporate social responsibility、non-profit provision 同 survival。
english: Firms are generally assumed to pursue profit maximisation; other aims include market share, corporate social responsibility, non-profit provision and survival.

chinese_original: 人嘅 wants 係無限，但資源（時間、土地、勞力、資本）係有限。
english: Human wants are unlimited, but resources (time, land, labour, capital) are limited.

chinese_original: 何姑娘：下一站係模擬試場 III，考 Ch.11–15，稍後開放。
english: Miss Ho: Next stop is Mock Exam Hall III, covering Ch.11–15. It opens later.

chinese_original: 何姑娘：以下人物同數字全部係虛構練習題。答啱我六條，干預徽章就係你嘅。
english: Miss Ho: All the people and numbers below are fictional practice questions. Get six right and the Intervention Badge is yours.

chinese_original: 何姑娘：好！你分析政策好有條理。
english: Miss Ho: Great! You analyse policies very methodically.

chinese_original: 何姑娘：我喺石硤尾做咗十年社工。1953 年聖誕石硤尾大火之後，政府喺呢度起徙置大廈，香港公營房屋就由呢度開始。
english: Miss Ho: I've been a social worker in Shek Kip Mei for ten years. After the Shek Kip Mei fire at Christmas 1953, the government built resettlement blocks here, and Hong Kong's public housing started right here.

chinese_original: 何姑娘：拎住干預徽章。記住：政策出發點好，都要問清楚邊個得益、邊個受損、有冇 deadweight loss。
english: Miss Ho: Take the Intervention Badge. Remember: even when a policy means well, always ask who gains, who loses, and whether there's a deadweight loss.

chinese_original: 何姑娘：政府落手干預市場，可以限價、定最低價、限量、徵稅、補貼。每一招都有人得益、有人受損，仲可能令 total social surplus 減少。
english: Miss Ho: When the government steps into the market, it can cap prices, set minimum prices, limit quantities, tax or subsidise. Every move has winners and losers, and may even reduce total social surplus.
Secures a stable supply of raw materials

chinese_original: 俾賣家 unit subsidy，supply curve 向下移，距離等於每單位補貼。消費者付嘅價格下跌，生產者收到嘅價格（市價 + 補貼）上升，成交量增加；elasticity 較低嗰一方得到較多好處。
english: Give sellers a unit subsidy and the supply curve shifts down by the subsidy per unit. The price consumers pay falls, the price producers receive (market price + subsidy) rises, and quantity transacted increases; the side with lower elasticity gains more.
Price has no tendency to change

chinese_original: 先判斷管制有冇效（上限低過 Pe、下限高過 Pe、配額低過 Qe）
english: First check whether the control is effective (ceiling below Pe, floor above Pe, quota below Qe)
A company is a separate legal entity

chinese_original: 共通動機：享受 economies of scale、更有效運用資源、擴大品牌效益。Horizontal（external）獨有：減少競爭。Vertical backward：保障原料供應；forward：保障銷售出路。Lateral／conglomerate：分散風險。
english: Common motives: enjoy economies of scale, use resources more efficiently, extend brand benefits. Unique to horizontal (external): reduce competition. Vertical backward: secure raw material supply; forward: secure sales outlets. Lateral/conglomerate: spread risk.

chinese_original: 冇生產嘅單位 MB > MC
english: Units not produced have MB > MC
Queues and a black market appear

chinese_original: 分清 government department 同 public corporation
english: Tell government department and public corporation apart

chinese_original: 分清 short run 嘅 diminishing returns 同 long run 嘅 economies of scale
english: Tell short-run diminishing returns apart from long-run economies of scale

chinese_original: 分清 simple、complex、regional division of labour
english: Tell simple, complex and regional division of labour apart

chinese_original: 分清沿線移動（自己價格）同成條線移（其他因素）
english: Tell movement along the curve (own price) from a shift of the whole curve (other factors)

chinese_original: 分清私人同社會成本或效益，再揀合適嘅解決方法
english: Tell private from social costs or benefits, then pick a suitable solution

chinese_original: 分清股東（擁有人、dividend）同債券持有人（債權人、interest）
english: Tell shareholders (owners, dividend) from bondholders (creditors, interest)

chinese_original: 分辨 positive 同 normative：可唔可以用事實推翻
english: Tell positive from normative: can it be refuted by facts?

chinese_original: 判斷產量或生活水平之前，先用 real = nominal ÷ deflator × 100 剔走價格變動
english: Before judging output or living standards, remove price changes with real = nominal ÷ deflator × 100

chinese_original: 加入完全唔相關嘅業務

english: Can only accept the market price

chinese_original: 只計放棄咗嘅最高價值選項
english: Count only the highest-valued option forgone

chinese_original: 只計新生產嘅最終產出（value added），剔走 transfers、二手貨同資產升值
english: Count only newly produced final output (value added); exclude transfers, second-hand goods and asset appreciation
Can sell the fishing boat to someone

chinese_original: 向賣家徵 unit tax，supply curve 向上移，垂直距離等於每單位稅款。一般情況下，消費者付嘅價格上升但升幅細過稅款；生產者收到嘅淨價格（市價 − 稅）下跌；成交量減少。
english: Levy a unit tax on sellers and the supply curve shifts up, with the vertical distance equal to the tax per unit. Normally the price consumers pay rises, but by less than the tax; the net price producers receive (market price − tax) falls; quantity transacted falls.

chinese_original: 周老闆：Ch.6–7 你已經上手，下一站可以去旺角睇市場點運作。
english: Boss Chow: You've got the hang of Ch.6–7. Next you can head to Mong Kok and see how markets work.

chinese_original: 周老闆：以下全部人物同數字都係虛構練習題。答啱我六條，我就俾工廈徽章你。
english: Boss Chow: All the people and numbers below are fictional practice questions. Get six right and I'll give you the Factory Badge.

chinese_original: 周老闆：你媽媽由深水埗車衣線過咗嚟我呢邊做拉長。想學做生意，就要識睇老闆點揀公司形式、點樣擴張。
english: Boss Chow: Your mum moved over from the Sham Shui Po sewing line to be a line leader on my side. If you want to learn business, you need to see how bosses choose a company type and how they expand.

chinese_original: 周老闆：唔錯，你識睇間廠嘅骨架。
english: Boss Chow: Not bad, you can see the skeleton of a factory.

chinese_original: 周老闆：後生仔，呢座工廈五樓到八樓都係我嘅廠。1985 年，成個觀塘有七千間工廠、二十萬工人。
english: Boss Chow: Young man, floors 5 to 8 of this industrial building are all my factory. In 1985, Kwun Tong had 7,000 factories and 200,000 workers.

chinese_original: 周老闆：拎住工廈徽章。記住：limited liability 保護嘅係股東唔係公司，而擴張唔係愈大愈好。
english: Boss Chow: Take the Factory Badge. Remember: limited liability protects the shareholders, not the company, and bigger expansion isn't always better.

chinese_original: 唯一賣家，冇相近替代品
因為人冇耐性，願意付 premium 提早得到物品。借方：interest 係提早得到資源嘅成本；貸方：interest 係延遲消費嘅補償。可以用 real goods 或 money 表示。利率上升 → 借錢意願下降、儲蓄意願上升、現在消費減少、將來消費增加。
english: Because people are impatient, they pay a premium to get goods earlier. For borrowers, interest is the cost of getting resources earlier; for lenders, interest is the reward for delaying consumption. It can be expressed in real goods or money. Interest rate rises → less willing to borrow, more willing to save, less consumption now, more consumption later.

chinese_original: 因為價格上升，quantity supplied 增加
english: Because price rises, quantity supplied increases
Discount for buying cloth in bulk

chinese_original: 好處：提高 labour productivity（善用 capital、揀最合適嘅人、熟能生巧、慳轉工序時間、慳訓練時間、促進機械化）同改善生活水平。壞處：沉悶、失去工作滿足感、失業風險、互相依賴、產品過度標準化。限制：產品性質（要創意）、市場太細。
english: Advantages: raises labour productivity (better use of capital, picking the best person for each job, practice makes perfect, saves time switching tasks, saves training time, encourages mechanisation) and improves living standards. Disadvantages: boredom, loss of job satisfaction, risk of unemployment, interdependence, over-standardised products. Limits: nature of the product (needs creativity), market too small.

chinese_original: 寄居蟹換咗大殼又想要更大
english: A hermit crab gets a bigger shell, then wants an even bigger one
Drying silver shrimp into shrimp paste

chinese_original: 將風險分散到幾種產品
專注生產唔同物品再交換
english: Specialise in different goods, then exchange

chinese_original: 工人做同一件恤衫嘅唔同工序
english: Workers do different processes on the same shirt
Money already paid that can't be recovered

chinese_original: 市場方法：產權清楚界定、交易成本低，受影響嘅人同製造 externality 嘅人可以自己傾（market exchange），將外部成本內部化；合併或收購亦可以。牽涉人數多、交易成本高就好難成功。
english: Market approach: with clearly defined property rights and low transaction costs, those affected and those creating the externality can negotiate themselves (market exchange), internalising the external cost; a merger or acquisition can also work. It rarely succeeds when many people are involved and transaction costs are high.

chinese_original: 幾個大賣家互相睇住對方
english: A few big sellers watch each other closely

chinese_original: 廠商擴大自己嘅生產規模，LRAC 下降 = internal economies of scale；超過 optimal scale 後 LRAC 上升 = internal diseconomies of scale。
english: A firm expands its own scale of production: falling LRAC = internal economies of scale; rising LRAC beyond the optimal scale = internal diseconomies of scale.
A firm expands its own scale

chinese_original: 徵 unit tax 可以減少消費（例如香煙）：demand 越 elastic，數量跌得越多；demand inelastic 時稅收多但數量跌得少。Unit subsidy 用嚟鼓勵生產或消費，要政府出錢。
english: A unit tax can reduce consumption (e.g. cigarettes): the more elastic demand is, the more quantity falls; when demand is inelastic, tax revenue is high but quantity falls little. A unit subsidy is used to encourage production or consumption and costs the government money.

chinese_original: 成交量係 Qd 同 Qs 較細嗰個
english: Quantity transacted is the smaller of Qd and Qs

chinese_original: 拉近收入：progressive income tax（收入越高，average tax rate 越高）、cash transfers（例如津貼）、transfers in kind（例如公屋、公營醫療）同 minimum wage。Minimum wage 可能令低技術工人失業，所以對收入差距嘅效果唔一定。
english: Narrowing income gaps: progressive income tax (the higher the income, the higher the average tax rate), cash transfers (e.g. allowances), transfers in kind (e.g. public housing, public healthcare) and minimum wage. Minimum wage may cause unemployment among low-skilled workers, so its effect on the income gap is uncertain.

chinese_original: 拉近機會：資助教育、資助醫療、反歧視法例、社會企業同職業培訓。追求 equity 可能犧牲 efficiency：高稅率同福利可能減低工作同投資意欲（disincentive effect）、實物資助令 MB ≠ MC，仲有行政成本。
english: Narrowing opportunity gaps: subsidised education, subsidised healthcare, anti-discrimination laws, social enterprises and vocational training. Pursuing equity may sacrifice efficiency: high tax rates and welfare may reduce incentives to work and invest (disincentive effect), in-kind subsidies make MB ≠ MC, and there are administrative costs too.

chinese_original: 持有配額嘅人賺額外收入
指出 historical cost 唔係 cost
english: Point out that historical cost is not a cost

chinese_original: 指出 market price 係分配資源嘅訊號
english: Point out that market price is the signal for allocating resources

chinese_original: 指出 opportunity cost 只計最高價值嘅放棄選項
english: Point out that opportunity cost counts only the highest-valued option forgone

chinese_original: 指出實際成交量係 Qd 同 Qs 之中較細嗰個
english: Point out that the actual quantity transacted is the smaller of Qd and Qs

chinese_original: 指出真正嘅 monopoly power 來源，唔係淨係大
english: Identify the real source of monopoly power, not just size
Chose to study, gave up moving goods for $50

chinese_original: 搵出 Pe 同 Qe，成交量取 Qd 同 Qs 較細嗰個
english: Find Pe and Qe; quantity transacted is the smaller of Qd and Qs

chinese_original: 收入唔平均嘅來源：天賦同能力、human capital（教育、培訓、經驗）、年齡、性別、技能嘅市場價值、compensating differentials（厭惡性或危險工作要俾多啲人工）、工資計算方法、工資歧視，同埋資本同物業擁有權唔平均（租金、利息、股息）。
english: Sources of income inequality: natural talent and ability, human capital (education, training, experience), age, gender, market value of skills, compensating differentials (unpleasant or dangerous jobs pay more), wage calculation methods, wage discrimination, and unequal ownership of capital and property (rent, interest, dividends).

chinese_original: 收入增加而佢係 inferior good
english: Income rises and it is an inferior good
Acquire the yarn mill that supplies the cloth

chinese_original: 收購生產同一種產品嘅對手
english: Acquire a rival making the same product
The government gives sellers a unit subsidy
The government pays sellers per unit

chinese_original: 政府統計師 程小姐
政府處理 externality 嘅方法：徵稅或收費（例如膠袋徵費）、法例管制、補貼、政府提供、專利同版權、公眾教育。每種方法都有限制，例如好難準確量度 external cost。
english: Government ways to handle externalities: taxes or charges (e.g. the plastic bag levy), legal controls, subsidies, government provision, patents and copyright, public education. Each has limits, e.g. external cost is hard to measure accurately.

chinese_original: 整個行業擴張，個別廠商嘅 LRAC 下降 = external economies of scale；行業過度擴張令 LRAC 上升 = external diseconomies of scale。
english: When the whole industry expands and an individual firm's LRAC falls = external economies of scale; when the industry over-expands and LRAC rises = external diseconomies of scale.

chinese_original: 時間嘅最佳其他用途嘅價值
english: value of the best alternative use of time
the price of a substitute rises

chinese_original: 替代品越多越接近 → 越 elastic；必需品較 inelastic；佔收入比例越大 → 越 elastic；時間越長 → 越 elastic；耐用品、習慣、用途多寡都會影響 Ed。
english: More and closer substitutes → more elastic; necessities are relatively inelastic; larger share of income → more elastic; longer time period → more elastic; durability, habits and the number of uses also affect Ed.

chinese_original: 有 externality 時，自由市場產量喺 MPB = MPC，但 efficient output 喺 MSB = MSC。Negative externality → 市場產量太多（over-production）；positive externality → 太少（under-production）；兩者都有 deadweight loss。
english: With an externality, the free market produces where MPB = MPC, but efficient output is where MSB = MSC. Negative externality → market output too high (over-production); positive externality → too low (under-production); both cause deadweight loss.

chinese_original: 有效嘅 price ceiling 下，價格唔可以分配貨品，就靠 non-price competition：排隊、先到先得、抽籤、人情。仲會出現 black market、額外收費、質素下降；排隊時間令 full price 上升。
english: Under an effective price ceiling, price can't allocate the good, so non-price competition takes over: queuing, first come first served, lotteries, personal connections. Black markets, extra charges and lower quality also appear; queuing time raises the full price.

chinese_original: 有效嘅 price ceiling 令成交量由 Qe 跌到 Qs，Qs 同 Qe 之間嗰啲單位 MB > MC 但冇生產，係 under-production，出現 deadweight loss，TSS 減少。PS 一定減少；CS 點變就唔確定（平咗得益，但買少咗損失）。
english: An effective price ceiling cuts the quantity traded from Qe to Qs. The units between Qs and Qe have MB > MC but are not produced: under-production, with deadweight loss and lower TSS. PS must fall; the change in CS is uncertain (gain from the lower price, loss from buying less).

chinese_original: 有效嘅 price floor 令成交量由 Qe 跌到 Qd，係 under-production，有 deadweight loss。CS 一定減少；PS 點變唔確定（貴咗得益，但賣少咗損失）。Minimum wage 定喺市場工資以上都會有同樣效果。
english: An effective price floor cuts the quantity traded from Qe to Qd: under-production, with deadweight loss. CS must fall; the change in PS is uncertain (gain from the higher price, loss from selling less). A minimum wage set above the market wage has the same effect.

chinese_original: 有效嘅 quota 令成交量跌到配額數量，價格上升，係 under-production，有 deadweight loss。CS 一定減少；持有配額嘅賣家 PS 可能增加（quota rent），TSS 一定減少。
english: An effective quota cuts the quantity traded to the quota amount and raises the price: under-production, with deadweight loss. CS must fall; quota-holding sellers' PS may rise (quota rent); TSS must fall.
dividends are paid only out of profit

chinese_original: 有限資源唔夠滿足無限 wants
english: limited resources can't satisfy unlimited wants
the business ends when the owner dies
the wage of fruit porters rises

chinese_original: 梁工：以下人物同數字全部係虛構練習題。答啱我六條，海港徽章就係你嘅。
english: Engineer Leung: All the people and numbers below are fictional practice questions. Get six of mine right and the Harbour Badge is yours.

chinese_original: 梁工：好！你分得清私人成本同社會成本。
english: Engineer Leung: Good! You can tell private cost from social cost.

chinese_original: 梁工：工廠同屋企倒落海嘅污水，成本唔係自己揹，係第三者揹：漁民、泳客、成個維港。政府出手可以修正，但出手唔啱又會製造新嘅 deadweight loss。
english: Engineer Leung: When factories and homes dump sewage into the sea, they don't bear the cost themselves. Third parties do: fishermen, swimmers, the whole of Victoria Harbour. Government action can correct this, but the wrong action creates new deadweight loss.

chinese_original: 梁工：巴士站有過海巴士去中環，學 Ch.18–20 收入分配同國民收入。你亦可以先挑戰我嘅困難模式。
english: Engineer Leung: There's a cross-harbour bus to Central at the bus stop. Learn Ch.18–20, income distribution and national income, there. Or you can take on my Hard mode first.

chinese_original: 梁工：我喺渠務署做咗二十年。2001 年 12 月淨化海港計劃第一期啟用，而家維港兩岸大約七成半污水都送去昂船洲處理。（來源：環境保護署）
english: Engineer Leung: I've worked at the Drainage Services Department for twenty years. Stage 1 of the Harbour Area Treatment Scheme opened in December 2001, and now about 75% of the sewage from both sides of Victoria Harbour goes to Stonecutters Island for treatment. (Source: Environmental Protection Department)

chinese_original: 梁工：拎住海港徽章。記住：efficient output 唔係市場自己搵到嗰個，而係 MSB = MSC 嗰點；政府干預亦要睇清楚會唔會 over-production 或者 under-production。
english: Engineer Leung: Take the Harbour Badge. Remember: efficient output isn't what the market finds on its own, it's where MSB = MSC. With government intervention, check carefully whether it causes over-production or under-production.

chinese_original: 標叔：以下全部人物同數字都係虛構練習題。答啱我六條，市場徽章就係你嘅。
english: Uncle Biu: All the people and numbers below are fictional practice questions. Get six of mine right and the Market Badge is yours.

chinese_original: 標叔：你喺女人街開檔，就要識分：邊啲市場係 price taker，邊啲係 price searcher；點樣定產量先賺得最多；價格點樣由供求決定。
english: Uncle Biu: If you run a stall on Ladies' Market, you need to tell: which markets are price takers and which are price searchers; how to set output to earn the most; how demand and supply set the price.

chinese_original: 標叔：你已經學完 Ch.6–10，試場第二份模擬卷等緊你。
english: Uncle Biu: You've finished Ch.6–10. The second mock paper in the exam hall is waiting for you.

chinese_original: 標叔：好！你睇市場有眼光。
english: Uncle Biu: Good! You've got an eye for markets.

chinese_original: 標叔：後生仔，我喺金魚街賣咗幾十年魚。呢度一條街幾十間舖，賣嘅魚都差唔多。
english: Uncle Biu: Young one, I've sold fish on Goldfish Street for decades. This one street has dozens of shops, all selling much the same fish.

chinese_original: 標叔：拎住市場徽章。記住：最大嘅舖唔一定係 monopoly，賣得最多亦唔一定賺得最多。
english: Uncle Biu: Take the Market Badge. Remember: the biggest shop isn't necessarily a monopoly, and selling the most doesn't necessarily mean earning the most.

chinese_original: 權力來自 patent 或者 franchise
english: power from a patent or a franchise
Correctly classifies what / how / for whom

chinese_original: 正確解讀 Lorenz curve 同 Gini：離對角線越遠 = A ÷ (A + B) 越大 = 越唔平均
english: Correctly reads the Lorenz curve and Gini: further from the diagonal = larger A ÷ (A + B) = more unequal

chinese_original: 正確計 TSS：有稅加 tax revenue，有補貼減 subsidy expenditure
english: Correctly calculates TSS: add tax revenue with a tax, subtract subsidy expenditure with a subsidy

chinese_original: 每檔貨品都有少少唔同
english: each stall's goods are a bit different

chinese_original: 每檔賣嘅產品一模一樣
比較政策後嘅成交量同 efficient quantity（Qe 或 MSB = MSC 嗰點）
english: Compares the post-policy quantity with the efficient quantity (Qe, or where MSB = MSC)

chinese_original: 法律將價格壓喺 Pe 以下
english: the price is kept below Pe by law

chinese_original: 海姐：不過成條大澳點運作，唔係淨係計數咁簡單。
english: Sister Hoi: But how the whole of Tai O works isn't just a matter of doing sums.

chinese_original: 海姐：二戰後入口鹽平，大澳鹽業喺 1950–1960 年代慢慢式微。村民成日喺度拗下一步點行。答得到我六條問題，先算你明白！
english: Sister Hoi: After WWII, imported salt was cheap, and Tai O's salt industry slowly declined in the 1950s–1960s. The villagers are always arguing about what to do next. Answer six of my questions, then I'll say you understand!

chinese_original: 海姐：你就係福伯個孫？聽講你識計成本。
english: Sister Hoi: So you're Grandpa Fuk's grandson? I hear you know how to work out costs.

chinese_original: 海姐：唔錯！你已經睇得明成條村點運作。
english: Sister Hoi: Not bad! You can already see how the whole village works.

chinese_original: 海姐：拎住墟市徽章。返屋企同阿爺傾吓，你哋一家人點揀。
english: Sister Hoi: Take the Market-town Badge. Go home and talk it over with Grandpa: what will your family choose?

chinese_original: 生產成本上升、unit tax → supply 減少；技術進步、unit subsidy → supply 增加。Joint supply：一樣多咗，另一樣都多咗。Competitive supply：另一件貨加價 → 呢件貨 supply 減少。賣家預期加價 → 而家 supply 減少。天氣、賣家數目都會影響 supply。
english: Higher production costs or a unit tax → supply falls; better technology or a unit subsidy → supply rises. Joint supply: more of one means more of the other. Competitive supply: the other good's price rises → this good's supply falls. Sellers expect a price rise → supply falls now. Weather and the number of sellers also affect supply.

chinese_original: 用 GDP 比較生活水平嘅限制：物價水平、人口、產出組合（軍火定消費品）、冇記錄嘅生產（家務、義工、地下經濟）、閒暇、污染、收入分配、質素，跨地區比較仲要考慮匯率同購買力。
english: Limits of using GDP to compare living standards: price level, population, output mix (weapons or consumer goods), unrecorded production (housework, volunteering, underground economy), leisure, pollution, income distribution, quality; cross-region comparisons must also consider exchange rates and purchasing power.

chinese_original: 用 MR = MC 決定產量；fixed cost 改變 profit 但唔改變產量
english: Uses MR = MC to decide output; fixed cost changes profit but not output

chinese_original: 用 TSS = Σ(MB − MC) 衡量 efficiency，並指出 deadweight loss
english: Uses TSS = Σ(MB − MC) to measure efficiency and identifies deadweight loss

chinese_original: 用 arc method 計 Ed，再連繫 TR 嘅變化
english: Uses the arc method to calculate Ed, then links it to the change in TR

chinese_original: 用 average tax rate 分辨 progressive、proportional 同 regressive tax
english: Uses the average tax rate to tell progressive, proportional and regressive taxes apart

chinese_original: 用「有冇第二間廠商參與」判斷 internal 定 external expansion
english: Asks "is a second firm involved?" to judge internal or external expansion

chinese_original: 用數量夠唔夠滿足所有人 wants 分辨 free good 同 economic good
english: Tells free goods from economic goods by whether the quantity is enough to satisfy everyone's wants

chinese_original: 用時間同貨品可唔可以儲存解釋 Es
english: Explains Es using time and whether the good can be stored

chinese_original: 用相對 elasticity 講 tax incidence，用新數量計稅收
english: Uses relative elasticity to explain tax incidence, and the new quantity to calculate tax revenue

chinese_original: 用賣家數目、產品性質、入行障礙同資訊判斷市場結構
english: Judges market structure by number of sellers, nature of product, barriers to entry and information

chinese_original: 由 incorporation 推出 limited liability、perpetual succession 同人數上限
english: Derives limited liability, perpetual succession and the limit on members from incorporation

chinese_original: 由法例成立、有獨立董事局
english: set up by an ordinance with its own board
cost of building the salt pans years ago
Stone lions (at the government office gate)

chinese_original: 福伯：乖孫，你捉咗咁多 EconMon，識唔識計數？
english: Grandpa Fuk: My boy, you've caught so many EconMon. Can you do the sums?

chinese_original: 福伯：你幫阿爺計清楚，先有資格過對岸！
english: Grandpa Fuk: Work it out properly for Grandpa, and then you'll have earned the right to cross over!

chinese_original: 福伯：好！阿爺曬咗幾十年鹽，都未必計得咁清楚。
english: Grandpa Fuk: Great! Grandpa's been drying salt for decades and might not work it out this clearly.

chinese_original: 福伯：對岸係墟市，成條村點樣運作，你去問海姐啦。
english: Grandpa Fuk: Across the water is the market town. To see how the whole village works, go and ask Sister Hoi.

chinese_original: 福伯：拎住呢個鹽花徽章。擺渡婆婆見到就會搖你過對岸。
english: Grandpa Fuk: Take this Salt-flower Badge. When Ferry Granny sees it, she'll row you across.

chinese_original: 福伯：阿爺而家每月可以揀：繼續曬鹽（$120）、出市區工廠打工（$180，每月車費 $20）、或者出海打魚（$150）。數字係阿爺計出嚟俾你練習嘅。
english: Grandpa Fuk: Each month Grandpa can choose: keep drying salt ($120), work in a factory in the city ($180, with $20 a month in fares), or go fishing at sea ($150). Grandpa made up these numbers for you to practise with.

chinese_original: 稅收 = 每單位稅 × 新成交量。消費者負擔 = (Pc − Pe) × Qt；生產者負擔 = (Pe − Pp) × Qt。消費者總開支 = Pc × Qt。補貼開支 = 每單位補貼 × 新成交量。
english: Tax revenue = tax per unit × new quantity traded. Consumer burden = (Pc − Pe) × Qt; producer burden = (Pe − Pp) × Qt. Total consumer spending = Pc × Qt. Subsidy expenditure = subsidy per unit × new quantity traded.

chinese_original: 程小姐：Ch.21 之後嘅新地區同第四個模擬試場稍後推出。你可以先挑戰我嘅困難模式。
english: Ms Ching: New areas after Ch.21 and the fourth Mock Exam Hall are coming later. You can take on my Hard mode first.

chinese_original: 程小姐：以下人物同數字全部係虛構練習題。答啱我六條，統計徽章就係你嘅。
english: Ms Ching: All the people and numbers below are fictional practice questions. Get six of mine right and the Statistics Badge is yours.

chinese_original: 程小姐：同一個中環，有人喺交易廣場做交易，有人喺後巷洗碗。一個 GDP 數字講唔晒；要睇分配、睇 real 定 nominal、睇 per capita。
english: Ms Ching: In the same Central, some people trade at Exchange Square and some wash dishes in the back alleys. One GDP figure can't tell the whole story: look at distribution, real vs nominal, and per capita.

chinese_original: 程小姐：好！你識得將數字拆開嚟睇。
english: Ms Ching: Good! You know how to break numbers down.

chinese_original: 程小姐：我喺政府統計處做咗十年。2017 年 6 月公布：2016 年按原本住戶收入計，Gini coefficient 係 0.539；計埋稅同社會福利轉移，就係 0.473。（來源：政府統計處新聞公報，2017 年 6 月 9 日）
english: Ms Ching: I've worked at the Census and Statistics Department for ten years. Published in June 2017: in 2016, based on original household income, the Gini coefficient was 0.539; after taxes and social benefit transfers, it was 0.473. chinese_original: 程小姐：拎住統計徽章。記住：GDP 量度生產，唔等於福利；Gini 量度分配，唔等於生活水平；nominal 升咗，real 未必升。
english: Ms Ching: Take the Statistics Badge. Remember: GDP measures production, not welfare; Gini measures distribution, not living standards; when nominal rises, real may not.
a shareholder is an owner of the firm

chinese_original: 蘭姐：下一站：去彌敦道巴士站搭巴士去石硤尾，睇吓政府點樣干預市場。

chinese_original: 蘭姐：以下全部人物同數字都係虛構練習題。答啱我六條，彈性徽章就係你嘅。
english: Sister Lan: All the people and numbers below are fictional practice questions. Get six of mine right and the Elasticity Badge is yours.

chinese_original: 蘭姐：你要識分：價格變係沿住條線郁，定係成條線移？兩條線一齊移，P 同 Q 邊個先確定？加價之後收入會多定少，就要睇 elasticity。
english: Sister Lan: You need to tell: when price changes, is it a move along the curve, or does the whole curve shift? When both curves shift, which of P and Q is certain? Whether revenue rises or falls after a price rise depends on elasticity.

chinese_original: 蘭姐：凌晨四點，果欄最旺。我喺度做咗三十年生果批發，一個颱風、一次疫症，價錢可以一晚變晒。
english: Sister Lan: At four in the morning, the Fruit Market is at its busiest. I've done fruit wholesale here for thirty years. One typhoon, one epidemic, and prices can change completely overnight.

chinese_original: 蘭姐：好！你睇市況有眼光。
english: Sister Lan: Good! You've got an eye for the market.
